title: Gravity Matcher
description: In Gravity Matcher, you’ll launch circles of various sizes and types into a dynamic gravity field. Your goal? Match identical circles by carefully aiming and timing your throws. But beware – gravity is unpredictable, and the slightest miscalculation can send your circles spiraling out of control!

title: Alphabet Lore Maze
description: Alphabet Maze: Escape Letters is an exciting puzzle game that will help develop the struggle of minds and learn the letters of the alphabet. In this educational game you will explore the maze, defeating monsters, teddy bear and letter creatures. Choose characters from the collection that include Huggy, Teddy Bear, Harry and many other unique characters. To get out of the maze, you need to choose rooms with a smaller number than yours and avoid monsters larger than your level.

title: Cookie Land
description: Step into Cookie Land, the ultimate sweet Match 3 adventure! Match cookies, candies, pies, donuts, cupcakes, and cotton candies to clear the board and trigger scrumptious chain reactions. Explore a fairytale-like saga map filled with colorful sweets, charming graphics, and a catchy soundtrack. With new treats raining down and endless levels of fun, Cookie Land is the most addictive, mouth-watering Match 3 game for all sweet lovers!

title: Helicopter Battle Steve 2 Player
description: Get on the helicopter and choose either the blue or red player. Destroy your friend’s helicopter to win the game.Winning is simple: just don’t let your helicopter crash! Jump and shoot to defeat your opponent. To beat the red or blue player, you must play your best. The player whose helicopter explodes the most will lose the game.

title: Super Tank Wrestle
description: Welcome to the world of tank battles, where you can control tanks to fight with other enemies on different maps. There are also a wealth of tanks for you to choose from!

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: Stick - Color War
description:
To defeat enemies you must shoot bullets of the same color as the enemy. 
Every five levels you have to defeat a boss.
Breaking off new weapons.
Will you be able to resist the colored sticks?
Play our shooter without downloads and registration.

title: Boolu Bask
description: Dunk Ball game is an exciting sports-based game that brings the thrills of basketball right to your device. The focus of the game is on scoring points by aiming each ball into the moving basket. Show off your agility, precision, and timing as you handle each ball with finesse and drop them into the basket for maximum points.

title: Pumpkin Patch
description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious world of a magical pumpkin farm, where pumpkins are so diverse and full of surprises that it's hard to tell one from the other! Your task is to carefully observe each pumpkin character and remember as many details as possible. Can you recognize and find two identical pumpkins among many others?

title: BMG: CrashDay 2025
description: The game "BMG: CrashDay 2025" is an arcade racing simulator that combines elements of action and realism. Players can choose from a variety of cars, each with its own unique characteristics and appearance. The game has various tracks, each with its own features, such as difficult turns, steep climbs and descents, as well as various obstacles.

title: Load The Dishes ASMR
description:
Load The Dishes ASMR is a puzzle game that puts you in comfort and fun! Your task is to sort different colored dishes and put them in the dishwasher. By organizing your cutlery in an organized way, you will find that this is not just a simple puzzle challenge, but also a super
relaxing ASMR sound experience.

title: Sniper Wars: Find the Criminal
description: The snipers have begun the battle! Find the villain among the crowd of citizens and eliminate him. Take a rifle and go on a dangerous mission to find the criminal! You have a photo of the criminal and a rifle, find him and eliminate him!

title: Basketball Fever
description:
Get ready for endless basketball fun! Basketball Fever features four exciting basketball challenges anyone can enjoy. 

Sharpen your aim, beat your high score, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade-style fun, Basketball Fever delivers nonstop action that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. It’s the ultimate way to test your reflexes, timing, and accuracy.

Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying physics make every shot feel rewarding.

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: Cop Simulator
description: Cop Simulator is an exciting and dynamic gaming experience that immerses you in the world of a lawman with unlimited possibilities. In this game you will take on the role of a cop, where you are given complete freedom of action.

title: DTA 2: Maniac
description: DTA 2: Maniac. Create chaos like GTA. Use a vast arsenal of weapons, steal bulldozers, buses, police cars, tanks and much more - destruction is all around!

title: Obby 3D Sprunki Parkour
description: Obby 3D Sprunki Parkour combines the best elements of obstacle challenges and parkour gameplay in an immersive 3D environment. The goal? Navigate through increasingly complex levels filled with moving platforms, tricky jumps, and narrow ledges while collecting coins and power-ups along the way. Each level offers unique challenges that test your timing, reflexes, and problem-solving skills.

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: Angry Flappy
description: "Angry Flappy is a fast-paced twist on the classic game, where players not only navigate through obstacles but also shoot bullets to destroy enemies and barriers. Get ready for an action-packed flying adventure!"

title: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker
description: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker is a fun and addictive brick-breaking game where a lively cat motivates you with cheerful meows. Your goal is to clear all the bricks without dropping the ball. As you break more bricks, the cat gets even more excited, dancing and playing around. With colorful graphics and dynamic gameplay, this game offers a delightful experience for players of all ages. Stay sharp and keep up!

title: American Block Sniper Online
description:
With its informal look reminiscent of Minecraft, American Block Sniper Online is a top-notch first-person action game. In addition to a large variety of adversaries and stages, the game has an extensive arsenal of weaponry.
American Block Sniper Online is a first-person action game in the world of Minecraft where you must defeat all the enemies in each level before time runs out.

title: LinkLink
description:
Round and cute animal blocks are piled up.
If you connect the same types together, you can get points by disappearing!
Let's compete to see who gets the highest score in a minute

title: What's In My Bag?
description: Unpack style and surprises in What’s In My Bag? – the ultimate dress-up and makeup game for fashion lovers! Choose cute outfits, glam makeup, and trendy bags, then reveal what’s inside each one. From influencer props to girly goodies, every bag tells a story. Get creative, show off your style, and join the viral “what’s in my bag” trend now! Perfect for fans of dress-up games, makeup fun, and aesthetic vibes.

title: My Tiny Market
description: In My Tiny Market, you're the boss of your very own supermarket. Manage your time and resources well to find the perfect balance between all your tasks: restock shelves, serve customers and keep everything running at full speed!

title: Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game
description:
Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game is a satisfying and addictive puzzle game where you tap on two or more matching blocks to smash them!
? Clear the board, create massive combos, and reach high scores in this colorful, fun-packed block smashing experience.
Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike!

title: Block Combo Blast
description: Enjoy a classic block puzzle game with exciting jewel blast gameplay and stunning visuals! Solve 1800+ challenging levels, earn combos, and climb the global leaderboard. Train your brain, relax with soothing sounds, and compete with friends for the top spot!

title: Hero Match
description:
Hero Match: Blast, Build & Save the World!
Welcome to Hero Match! Join our fearless superhero, solve match 3 puzzles, take down the villain, and restore iconic locations across the globe!

title: Deadflip Frenzy
description:
Deadflip Frenzy is a wild stunt-flipping action game where chaos meets style! Launch your character into the air, pull off insane flips, twists, and bone-crunching landings — all in the name of fun (and maybe a little destruction).

Bounce off trampolines, launch from cannons, smash through obstacles, and aim for the most outrageous combos. The more insane your flip, the higher your score. But beware — one bad landing and it’s ragdoll mayhem!

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Rush Car Driving - Race Master
description:
Rush Car Driving: Race Master is a driving game that delivers thrilling action as you navigate heavy traffic. 

Experience the adrenaline of high-speed racing in heavy traffic, where split-second decisions can be the difference between victory and defeat. Explore a variety of immersive environments, from busy urban highways to rural roads. 

Choose from a wide selection of cars, from sports cars to muscle machines. Buckle up and start the race!

title: Smash The Bottle
description: Bottle Smash Arcade is a fun, casual arcade smash game where you shatter bottles in wild combos—perfect for fans of cool math games and Roblox-style thrills. Master quick reflexes like in Minecraft challenge levels, or go old-school with snake game breaks. Upgrade bottle-breaking action, smash for points, crush boredom Kahoot-style in this playful, fast-paced smash-the-bottle adventure!

title: Square Punki Long Hand
description: Ever wondered what life would be like with super long arms? In Square Punki Long Hand, you get to experience just that! This unique puzzle game challenges you to stretch, grab, prank, and solve hilarious puzzles using your extra-long limbs. Whether you're rescuing trapped characters, reaching impossible places, or pulling off mischievous tricks, every level is filled with surprises and laughter!

title: Single Stroke Line Draw
description:
Single Stroke Draw Line is a puzzle game with with one touch line drawing. It is required for you to draw one line to connect all the points without any route repetition.
- The rule is very simple, Draw given figures with only one touch.
- Explore amazing levels of this puzzle at your fingertips and sharpen your brain IQ & skills.
- Game level starts with very easy levels and increases in difficultly as you progress in the game.

title: Push The Frog
description: Control your little frog to eat all the mosquitoes. Master the length of the frog's tongue and make the frog reach the appropriate position to eat the mosquitoes. Think carefully about planning the route. The game has a simple and interesting style, and the gameplay is educational and novel. It is very suitable for playing when killing time.

title: Big Block Blast
description:
Place triangles and blocks to build 2x2 BIG BLOCKS! Drag and drop shapes into the grid to complete full squares made of triangles. Matching colors gives you bonus points, so in Big Block Blast you must aim for smart and colorful combos!
Some blocks have special powers and can even be placed on top of others. Use them strategically to unlock new moves and clear space. Big Block Blast is a simple to play game but tricky to master! How many BIG BLOCKS can you make?

title: Hard Puzzle
description:
Enter a vibrant, calming world of geometry where your goal is to build perfect squares from colorful pieces. Fit the shapes together, unlock new levels, and challenge your logic and spatial skills. Need help? Use a hint to keep going!
? Easy to play, hard to master
? Relaxing visuals
? A quick, fun brain boost anytime
Start puzzling and become a geometry master!

title: Mr Bullet: Stealth Ninja Killstreak
description: Stealth action about a special agent! Third-person shooter about secret missions. Shootouts with stickmen. Physical destruction! Battles with dangerous Bosses. Tanks, Helicopters, Mutants! Road chases with destructible cars and much more!

title: Hotel Fever Tycoon
description: Wanna be a Hotel Empire Tycoon or a Top Cooking Chef? Come to "Hotel Fever Tycoon" to start an interesting hotel management and cooking journey with Emma and Uncle George! Work together to build your world-class hotel chain!

title: Farm Business Saga
description: Create the farm you’ve always wanted in Farm Business Saga! ? Plant crops, care for animals, trade products, and grow your farming empire. With beautiful visuals, endless ways to customize, and engaging simulation gameplay, it’s fun for all ages!

title: Bottle Logic
description: Bottle Logic is a satisfying drag-and-drop puzzle where you move and organize bottles into the correct places with smooth, intuitive controls. Enjoy 500+ handcrafted levels that steadily increase in challenge—providing the perfect daily brain cardio—plus an endless mode for non-stop play. Perfect for quick sessions or long relaxing runs, this game is designed for puzzle lovers who enjoy strategic thinking and clean, minimalist visuals.

title: Nubik Courier An Open World
description: Become a top pizza delivery expert! Race through city streets, dodge obstacles, and switch between vehicles to deliver pizzas on time. Earn money, upgrade your gear, and master exciting challenges. Fast-paced, fun, and addictive—start delivering now!

title: Soccer Tournament
description: Soccer Tournament is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Little master of assembly
description: The gameplay of this game is puzzle assembly type, mainly according to the room suggested by the picture, according to the objects in the room, the use of parts to splice the room objects

title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

title: Find the Ghost Cat
description: Your mission is to track down elusive ghost cats! These sneaky felines are masters of camouflage, blending into their surroundings, fading into transparency, or hiding in shadows. Stay sharp and see if you can find them all!

title: Through the Wall 3D
description: Through the Wall 3D takes the mind-bending puzzle gameplay of the original Through the Wall to a whole new level with stunning 3D graphics! Test your reflexes, strategy, and flexibility as you contort your character to match a variety of dynamic shapes in a visually immersive world.

title: Merge TikTok Gravity Knife
description: This is an addictive elimination merge puzzle game. If you like synthetic elimination games, then this game is for you. They can remove a portion of the weapons that didn't merge, but there's only one free shot. Be careful, you have to score as many points as possible within the time limit, otherwise, you will have to start another game. Now join the challenging world of the game.

title: Arrow Count Master
description: Arrow Count Master is a fast and satisfying runner where every choice changes your firepower. Swipe to move and choose between gates that add, subtract, multiply, or boost your arrows. Build the biggest arrow count possible while avoiding penalties and obstacles along the way.

title: Girl Rescue Dragon Out
description: In Girl Rescue: Dragon Out!, evil dragons and sneaky snakes are threatening a helpless girl. Only you can save her! This exciting rescue puzzle game blends shooting, colorful match mechanics, and epic boss battles into one exciting adventure! Click on the correct color cannon to destroy the corresponding color part of this flying dragon.

title: Word Rivers
description: Play Word Rivers - an exciting word game where you can enjoy a sea of words and fantastic crosswords. Find words from letters and discover the wonders of the world and words right now!

title: CS: Upgrade Gun
description: The weapon is alive and ready to go hunting! In this fast-paced launcher, you control a cannon that runs itself and shoots at targets. Collect boosters, improve their performance and last as long as possible. The further you go, the more action and explosions!

title: Paint race
description: Run around the circle and jump over dark obstacles. Paint the circle to pass levels. Collect the stars. Enjoy and get fun.

title: Guess The Italian Brainrot Animals
description: Get ready for a wild and hilarious ride with Guess the Italian Brainrot Animals, a fast-paced, emoji-fueled trivia game that tests your knowledge of 64 iconic Italian Brainrot characters! From the most famous to the obscure, this game challenges you to guess the correct character based on three emoji clues before the timer runs out. Think you’re a Brainrot expert? Prove it!

title: Cosmo Puzzle
description: Cosmo Puzzle is a colorful puzzle game about a robot who dreams of collecting a collection of minerals from all over the Solar System.

title: Tunnel Road
description: Tunnel Road is an adrenaline-filled arcade game that requires quick reflexes, sharp focus and a great visual reaction! Keep up with the speed, avoid obstacles and cover the longest distance while advancing in a colorful and dynamic tunnel!

title: ColorWars.io
description: ColorWars.io is a competitive multiplayer strategy game where players battle for territorial dominance. Expand your color by painting the arena, manage a real-time gold economy to deploy defensive structures, and eliminate rivals by targeting their trails. Balance aggressive expansion with tactical defense to climb the global leaderboard.

title: Bolts and Nuts - Puzzle
description:
An educational and exciting game in which you can test your logical and strategic thinking.
Solve unique puzzles to while away the time and relax with excellent soundtrack. A bright and exciting game is perfect not only for children, but will also give you the opportunity to test your skills in solving difficult problems for adults.

title: Words with Owl
description: Test your spelling skills and word recognition in this fun and challenging game! Complete words by filling in the missing letters and aim for the highest score. Unlock exciting new stages as you progress and enjoy a rewarding wordplay experience.

title: Pixel Flow
description: Come to train your brain with colors and paths. Pixel Flow is a clean and addictive pixel puzzle game that challenges your logic and planning skills. In each level, you must send kittens of different colors into the track. Pixel points matching the kittens' colors will be eliminated. Paths cannot cross or overlap, so every move matters.

title: Unscrew Them All
description: Unscrew Them All is a challenging  puzzle game where players must strategically unscrew all the screws securing large wooden planks to the board. After removing each screw, place it into the correct open slot. Unscrew all the planks before time runs out to complete each level. Master every level to win the game!

title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
description: Immerse yourself in Flag Jam, a unique blend of puzzle-solving, flags collecting, and visual ASMR effects! Tap to match banner pieces, watch them glide smoothly into place, and clear the board as you complete each flag. With easy-to-learn mechanics and stunning visual effects, Flag Jam is the perfect game to help you unwind.

title: Fire snake
description: Help the fire snake slither safely home! Dodge dangerous obstacles, collect shiny coins, and master tricky levels. Can you guide the snake through every challenge? Play now and test your skills!

title: Snake Puzzle 3D
description:
Get ready to unravel a tangled knot of snakes to solve this puzzle! ?? Dive into the world of puzzle-solving games to become the legendary tangle master 3D! ??

Knock-knot! Who’s there? Riddle. Riddle who? Riddle me this: how do you unravel a twisted tangle of serpents? With your sharp puzzle-solving skills! ? Welcome to Snake Knot: Sort Puzzle Game where your logic and gaming skills will be tested! Sort serpents to unknot every twisted tangle and free every color snake!

title: Bird Sort Challenges
description:
Bird Sort Challenges  is a fun and relaxing game where you sort colorful birds perched on branches, arranging them by matching colors.
Test your problem-solving skills as you strategize to ensure no branch overflows and complete each puzzle efficiently.
Whether you’re looking to unwind or sharpen your mind, Bird Sort: Color Sort Puzzle offers endless entertainment in a cheerful and visually pleasing world.
Good luck!

title: Tic Tac Toe Merge
description:
Tic-Tac-Toe Merge is a revolutionary twist on the classic game! Unlike traditional tic-tac-toe, pieces have power levels from 1 to 3. Place higher-level pieces to capture your opponent's weaker ones!

MERGE TO DOMINATE
Combine two level-1 pieces to create level-2, and two level-2 to forge powerful level-3. Create chain reactions when 3+ same-level pieces align — they merge into an even stronger piece!

title: Color Sort Puzzle
description: Spend your time wisely, relaxing and training your mind all at once! Put the water in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Cat Escape
description: Play Cat Escape, the viral cat puzzle hide-and-seek game now free online! Sneak past guards, dodge traps, and guide your kitty to safety across hundreds of stealth levels. Unlock skins, collect coins, and outsmart enemies in this browser cat game loved worldwide. Want the full mobile experience? Discover more at CatEscapeTheGame.com

title: Girly Puzzle
description: Place blocks on the grid to form vertical or horizontal rows. When no more blocks can be placed, the game is over. Collect items to increase Your Score!

title: Spooky Link
description: Spooky Link is a relaxing Halloween-themed game where you connect matching spooky tiles. Tap a tile, then tap its match. If the path between them has two or fewer turns, the tiles are cleared. Each cleared tile creates more space to connect others. Enjoy many levels of fun with Halloween surprises!

title: Halloween Challenge
description: Get ready for a spooky adventure in Halloween Challenge! Bats are flying through the night, carrying candy that you must protect. Your mission? Tap the bats before they escape with the sweet treats. But beware, if even one bat escapes, the game is over! With simple controls and addictive gameplay, Halloween Challenge offers a fun and fast-paced experience for players. Test your reflexes, compete for high scores, and enjoy the eerie Halloween atmosphere. How long can you defend the candy?

title: Crazy Plane Landing
description:
Flying is easy - but can you stick the landing?

Get into one of the amazing flying machines and launch as high as you can. This part is easy… well, fairly easy. Not that anyone can do it. But you can. Surely you do!

What’s really interesting is what happens next. Will you crash? Or will you somehow make it a perfect landing?

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Daring Jack
description:
Jack, an adventurer, was flying over the sea in his small aircraft. When he reached a jungle island, his aircraft's engine failed and he lost control. He escaped from the crashing aircraft, landed safely on the island, and now must find a boat to leave.

He knows of the old boathouse on the island but is uncertain how to reach it. Guide him through the jungle to the boathouse. Help him gather items for survival, focusing on securing food and shelter while navigating the challenging terrain.

title: Madness Cars Destroy
description:
The game features 6 unique modes:

Funnel: Push cars into the abyss as the funnel narrows!
Rotating Cube: Stay on the spinning cube, which speeds up over time!
Deadly Arena: Dodge falling bombs and collapsing floors—or shoot players instead!
Right Color: Inspired by Roblox, but with cars!
Deadly Bouncers: Avoid spinning mines in a gladiator-style arena!
Hot Potato: Pass the bomb or explode!
Choose from foreign or Russian cars and dive into the action!

title: SUV Traffic Racer
description: In SUV Traffic Racer, you will be playing SUVs through stunning endless highways. Skim through the highway traffic and make the highest score by going as far as you can, Unlock more than 6 SUVs to make the ultimate SUV garage. Upgrade your SUV with 4 awesome upgrades and get the most out of those roaring engines. Enjoy the picturesque highways and conquer it with your driving skills. Are you ready to show if you're the finest highway racer out there?

title: House Robber
description: House Robber is a free online game with the theme of a robber for boys. In the game, you will play a robber, sneak into the house and steal all kinds of goods. Be careful to return after you get it, and don't be found by the security guard. Each level has its own scene, so you must be careful in stealing. The whole process is very exciting, are you confident to surpass it? Come and challenge!

title: Witch & Fairy BFF
description: Two unusual girlfriends - a Fairy and a Witch - study together, although they are so different. Fairy, with her delicate pink outfits and impeccable sense of style, is always ready to offer fashion tips and create vivid images. Her girlfriend-Witch, who prefers a Gothic style, chooses mysterious and gloomy outfits. Players will be able to help both heroines choose outfits for various events. Join magical friends in their exciting fashion adventure where style and magic go hand in hand!

title: Racing Car Destroying Zombie
description:
Zombie Racing Car fast-paced physics-based racing game. You’re in for the ride of your life through a zombie apocalypse!

Drive your car through deserts, forests, abandoned city,...surrounded by zombies, earn cash, upgrade your car powerful ones. Steer your car to keep balance on the hills while trying to smash zombies into debris. It's you against a boatload of super-strong zombies!

title: Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl, where you can live out your fashion dreams and become a master of anime dress-up!

title: Sniper Shot Secret Mission
description:
Sniper Shot Secret Mission is a game of nerves and skills. Each time you start the new level, a challenge is waiting for you to solve. Never fire on the wrong target otherwise their no second chance as a sniper. 
As a sniper you need to work silently once you shoot the bullet everyone will be aware of the situation and you might loose your target. You can be targeted through security guards once you shoot at your high profile targets.

title: Pogo Masters
description: Bounce into action in Pogo Masters! Race against rivals in chaotic, physics-based platform battles where balance is everything. Compete online against players worldwide or challenge a friend locally on the same PC. Unlock dozens of unique characters, stylish pogo sticks, and eye-catching trail effects as you climb the global leaderboard. Fast-paced, competitive, and endlessly fun — become the ultimate pogo champion!

title: Crazy Axe
description:
In Crazy Axe, you take control of a fearless warrior, armed with a powerful axe, to conquer a series of action-packed challenges. Swing your axe with precision, crush obstacles, and defeat waves of enemies. The game tests your reflexes and accuracy as you navigate through dangerous environments, dodging traps and outsmarting your foes. With each level, the difficulty ramps up, demanding quick thinking and faster reactions to survive.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and go axe-crazy?

title: Cute Sheep SkyBlock
description: Two cute sheep must jump from island to island in the sky to escape from the farmers and reach the portal. They need to work together as a team to overcome obstacles. You must help them. Be careful of the obstacles that fall from the ground and sky. The farmers are looking for you, and they want to catch you, so jump over them to escape. If the path is clear, eat all the hay you find. Gather all the hay and safely reach the portal.

title: Words from words: Sea
description:
An exciting game where you need to find words from the given letters and solve hidden words in crosswords.  

Welcome to the game "Words from words: Sea" - where many words and interesting crosswords are waiting for you. Make words from letters, discover new words from words, and enjoy the amazing world where words turn into magic. Join us right now and dive into the world of fillwords, creating and finding the most amazing words!  

Dive into the world of exciting levels and find all the words!

title: Brain Challenge
description:
This game will challenge your mind, think out of the box
Unexpected and mind-blowing answers will amaze you
250 Fun levels.

Features:
- Solve fun & mind-challenging puzzles
- Think out of the box
- Simple & addictive gameplay

title: Tap-Hold
description: Tap & Hold is a fast-paced neon cyberpunk flight arcade game. Hold to fly up, release to fall down. Navigate through dangerous obstacles, collect coins, grab power-ups, and unlock unique characters. How far can you fly?

title: Sprunki PopIt
description: Sprunki PopIt: The Ultimate Bubble-Popping Adventure! Get ready for hours of bubbly fun with Sprunki PopIt, the free-to-play online game that kids everywhere are going crazy for! It’s fast, colorful, and packed with exciting challenges. Your goal? Pop all the bubbles, dodge obstacles, and conquer level after level of pure popping chaos!

title: Draw Bridge: Brain Game
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle - Draw Game is an exciting and challenging brain game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. In this bridge-building adventure, your task is to draw paths for the car to safely navigate through obstacles and reach its destination. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of bridge construction and puzzle-solving as you draw roads to rescue the stranded car!

title: Brawl Stars Brave Adventure
description: Brawl Stars Brave Adventure is a casual battle game designed for brave boys who love fast-paced action and nonstop adventure. Control fearless heroes as you battle enemies, avoid traps, and blast your way through nervous levels. Defeat monsters to constantly upgrade. Choose your skills to ensure your survival or increase your damage! Keep moving to avoid enemy attacks! Complete all levels to win. Get coins to unlock a variety of awesome weapons. Like darts, axes, etc.

title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2
description: The beloved classic returns! In Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2, connect matching butterflies in this beautifully refreshed game,  featuring new wing colors, enhanced animations, updated UI, and countless levels to complete . Can you clear each level before time runs out? Collect coins to unlock new backgrounds and stunning butterfly wings in the updated shop! A relaxing, fun puzzle for all ages!

title: Snake Classic
description: Snake Classic: A modern twist on the nostalgic snake game. Navigate your snake through six unique modes: Classic, Box, Tunnel, Mill, Condo, and Rail. Collect fruits and gems, customize your snake with skins, and enjoy multi-language support. Compete on personal leaderboards and play on both PC and mobile. Fun and engaging for all ages!

title: The Office Escape
description: The Office Escape is an exciting adventure where every step towards freedom becomes a test for the Regime and the thinking factor!

title: Halloween Stickman
description: On Halloween when the air was thick with mystery and the streets were decorated with carved pumpkins, you were ready to enjoy the spooky night. But Stickman, your sly friend and perennial trickster set you up and you are in trouble. It's time to punish him in every possible way. How? Yes, you have the super ability to rewind time. So take advantage of it and  punish your enemy on Halloween!

title: Kingdom match
description: Kingdom match is a competitive match-3 game with castle decoration options! Complete levels, compete with other players and build the best castle!

title: Gummy merge
description: Jelly merge is an endless game in which to merge identical marmalades. The goal of the game is to reach the final marmalade.

title: Mermaid Princess Avater Castle
description: This is a dress-up and decorating game for girls. If you like games where you create your world, you can't miss our game. There is a group of mermaids living in the underwater world and you can live with them and create beautiful memories.

title: Merge Master
description: A casual mobile game centered around matching and elimination. The game features vibrant colors, coupled with a visual style rich in beach elements. With background music and sound effects reminiscent of leisurely walks along the beach, it creates a relaxed beach-strolling environment that immerses players in an auditory experience.

title: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2
description: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a famous snake-hunting game when Sprunki head and Squid head as main avatar character in this game. You become a small snake that runs endlessly and continuously moves to eat the food, each time it eats it will become longer. Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a simple game that became an instant success soon after its launch.

title: Flip It 3D
description: In this fun and challenging puzzle platform game, test your strategic thinking as you navigate through levels where flipping platforms is the key to survival! Goblins and knights have different abilities, and they must be moved carefully across platforms to complete each level. But be careful—characters can only survive a limited number of flips, and platforms can't be flipped if they are occupied!

title: Color Rings Block Puzzle
description: Color Rings Block Puzzle is a fun and addictive mobile game that challenges your problem-solving skills and reflexes. The game is simple to play but difficult to master, making it perfect for both casual and hardcore gamers.

title: Battleship
description: Battleship is a classic strategy game where you compete against an enemy to sink their fleet of ships. Each player places their ships on a hidden grid and takes turns guessing the locations of the opponent’s ships. The first player to sink all of the enemy’s ships wins the game. It’s a test of strategy, memory, and luck!

title: High Heel Design
description: Imagine you are a fashion shoemaker who produces the best high heels ever. In High Heel Design, you are in charge of fashion shoe design. Yes, what you produce is not sneakers, sandals, or boots, but high heels only! Unleash your creativity and combine elements to realize your own stunning high heels in this shoe-designing game.

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Paws & Pals Diner
description:
Welcome to Paws & Pals Diner!

Step into the paws of a diner manager and embark on a delightful 2D adventure where every customer and staff member is an adorable animal! In this charming and whimsical world, you'll manage a bustling diner filled with furry friends, unlock delicious foods, and attract a variety of cute customers.

Are you ready to create the diner of your dreams and make every animal's visit a memorable one?

Join Paws & Pals Diner today!

title: Grill It All
description: Grill it all is a cooking-themed match-3 puzzle game. Play as a grill expert, matching identical skewers to complete orders. Strategically arrange ingredients like fish, leeks, and meatballs on grills. Test your observation and speed while using upgrade tools for strategic depth!

title: Daily Chess Puzzle
description: Enjoy over 700 daily chess puzzles in a sunny, beach-themed world. Lighthearted, relaxing, and perfect for summer fun anytime.

title: Harvesting Veggies
description: Players will take on the role of a farmer, planting vegetables and achieving a full row or column to harvest. The game is based on a cartoon style, with a fresh and cute overall aesthetic, making it fun and addictive to play.

title: Office Solitaire
description: Office Solitaire is the classic solitaire variant with the objective of collecting all the cards to the top row in suited sequences from ace to king.

title: Cube Stack 2048
description:
Cube Stack 2048 is a highly addictive casual game inspired by the classic puzzle game 2048, but with exciting new gameplay!
Merge numbered cubes to double their value, reach 2048, or even higher! Try to make it to the end.
Explore tons of amazing and challenging levels by merging cubes, avoiding obstacles, and collecting money!

title: Race It: Car Racing
description: Play Race It: Car Racing free online and jump into a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Challenge rivals in intense 1v1 city races, swipe to drift, time your boosts, and outsmart opponents in a skill-based brain game of reflex and control. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for quick breaks and nonstop racing action.

title: End Of World
description:
There are only 337 coins left in the world, collect them faster than the rest

You will appear in a post-apocalyptic world 

With coins, you can unlock unique items in the world, but you'll have to find them first

Summoning waves you can get even more coins
if you don't let the monsters get close to you

By completing the race, you will be able to convert your achievements into victory points and buy a unique incredibly powerful weapon!

And remember, you need to collect all the coins!

title: Sorting Candy Factory
description: A great puzzle game in the sorting genre. At the candy factory, all the candies are mixed up, sort the candies into flasks so that they can be packed and shipped according to orders. The game has many levels with increasing difficulty!

title: Friday Night Sprunki
description: Take on the challenge of a rhythm-based rap battle against many famous characters and hit the correct arrow keys in time with the music that starts playful and energetic but takes on a haunting vibe halfway through. Complete every level to beat the other characters and reach the best score on every Friday weekend. Complete all weeks and be part of the memorable and immersive experience.

title: Mojicon Winter Connect
description:
The Mojicon series returns for the holidays! Match festive tiles, break the new Ice Sheet blockers, and enjoy a relaxing winter puzzle adventure. ❄️
Mojicon Winter Connect takes the classic Onet matching fun you love and covers it in a layer of fresh snow. Immerse yourself in a cozy holiday atmosphere, connecting festive icons like reindeer, gingerbread men, and happy snowmen.
Fast, satisfying, and full of seasonal charm – it’s the perfect winter puzzle for all ages. ✨✨✨

title: Pin Puzzle Save The Sheep
description: Pin Puzzle: Save The Sheep is an exciting pin-pulling game. You will test your brain intelligence and have endless fun. In this game, you have to make the sheep eat food and save them from their predicament. You have many other tasks like pulling the pin to make the dog eat the food. But be aware that you may meet a lot of obstacles like bombs, lava, etc. and you need to avoid them. There are many interesting levels to play in this crazy puzzle game. Come and join the game.

title: Winter Wonderland Mahjong
description: Escape into a cozy Winter Wonderland filled with snowflakes, penguins, and festive cheer! Relax with calming music as you match beautifully crafted tiles in this soothing Mahjong puzzle game. Unlock charming new backgrounds and unique tile designs as you progress, each adding warmth and wonder to your journey. Perfect for unwinding, celebrating the holidays, and discovering the magic of winter—one match at a time.

title: Wild Hunting Clash
description: Challenge yourself and hunt beautiful animals in stunningly luscious woods. The calming sounds of the forest and lovely graphics will capture your heart. Feel like a true hunter in the unconquered wilderness!

title: Candy Monster Raffi
description: Help the candy monster Raffi eat all the candies! He absolutely loves them – all he wants is to eat candy. But be careful while collecting them! If you jump in the wrong direction, you might hit dangerous spikes. This cute little monster is hungry – run and feed Raffi with as many candies as you can!

title: Monster Girls Back to School
description: Welcome to Monster Girls Back To School. Join the Monster Girls as they prep for school! Assist them in selecting the ideal outfits for a stylish return. Dive into their supernatural world, full of fashion choices and exciting back-to-school adventures. Get ready to be their fashion guide and have fun!

title: Christmas sorting
description:
Christmas Sorting is a relaxing game for all ages. Place objects next to each other to collect 3 identical objects in a row.
Collect all the unique decorations for a Christmas atmosphere.
Create Christmas coziness, decorate the Christmas tree the way you want.

title: Grow Castle Defence
description: It's a completely different castle defense game. Strengthen your soldiers and prepare them for battle. Upgrade your archers for a better defense. Fight different enemies by leveling up. Each level adds to the excitement of the game. Watch as the enemies of the pal world evolve as you face them. Earn coins for each enemy and grow stronger.

title: Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war
description:
Complete levels, collecting items that you can then put on yourself and improve in your inventory. You can finish off your enemies with colorful fatalities. Try different skill combinations to complete as many levels as possible. 
Game features:

- Fights with stickmen
- Skins: warrior, fighter, ninja
- Enemies: red stickman, black stickman
- Various biomes

Did you like the game "Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war"? - Then write a review and play all our games about stickmen.

description: Lava Jump is a fast-paced parkour platformer set in a deadly lava-filled dungeon! Jump across moving blocks, bounce off boost pads, and ride shifting platforms to survive. Complete more than 25 levels, evade enemies, spikes and other deadly objects and escape from the lava dungeon alive. Collect coins and get new characters to use in your adventure.

title: 2048 - Blocks destruction
description: 2048 - Blocks destruction is endless fun! Rules are simple: shoot balls, destroy blocks and grow numbers. Get balls with bigger numbers and reach higher scores! Get a lot of balls or merge them and increase damage drastically!

title: Star Wing
description: Earth's last hope is in your hands, take control of the lone spaceship and protect Earth from alien swarms. Your goal will be quite challenging as you will have to save the Universe from its evil enemies. In this space shooting game, you will be facing an increasingly large number of enemies in hazardous environments. As the game progresses, you will earn the right to upgrade your spacecraft to unleash its full lethal capacity.

title: Ultimate Plants TD
description: Ultimate Plants TD is an army of plants to protect your garden from countless zombies. Your goal is to protect your garden from challenging waves of zombies. Experimenting with different plant combinations and positioning is the key to maximizing your defense capabilities and overcoming tough challenges!

title: Princess Rescue: Save Girl
description: Dive into a heart-pounding quest in Princess Rescue: Save Girl, a thrilling puzzle adventure full of danger, strategy, and fast-paced action! If you're into dragon-themed puzzles that test your reflexes and thinking skills, this is your next favorite game.

obstacles, and solve every puzzle!

Keep running through colorful 3D platform tracks and collecting tasty ingredients to build the tallest skewer stack ever. Slide to collect noodles, Chicken thighs, chili, and more as you dash forward.

Collect water to survive, avoid hazards, and uncover surprises across exciting levels. Choose from Levels mode for challenges or Endless mode to climb the global leaderboard. Customize your root with stylish hats and enjoy minimalistic graphics and relaxing sounds in this unique underground adventure!

Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle
description: Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle presents a fresh take on the classic word puzzle genre. With an array of unique gameplay mechanics, hints, and events, players are immersed in an engaging experience. The game's USP is its diverse content, offering a wide range of quotes across various themes, from inspirational to literary and beyond.

In Brooms Town, you must solve four amazing adventures:

title: Traffic Tap Survival
description: Traffic Tap Survival is a fast-paced traffic puzzle game where every tap matters. Control busy intersections, avoid crashes, and guide cars through dangerous roads filled with obstacles and tight turns. With simple controls, challenging levels, and intense survival gameplay, this addictive traffic management game will test your timing and reflexes. Perfect for fans of car puzzle games, traffic control games, and casual brain challenges.

title: Hero Rabbit Idle Survivor RPG

We have 4v4 Team Mode, Individual Mode, and Sniper Mode for you to select. If I were you, I would play the Team Mode first for better equipment, then challenge the other 2 modes when the rank levels up. If you never played any shooting games, I recommend you buy an auto-rifle to fight at any distance. Keep calm and shoot first!

title: Tile Match: The Immersive Puzzle

Match. Merge. Master the Tiles!

title: Dalgona Master
description:
Welcome to Dalgona Master, a thrilling game for those who loves dalgona, honeycomb, cookie game, and dalgona challenges.

This engaging sweet game challenge invites you to carve delicate shapes out of honeycomb candy, immersing you in the delicate skill required to perfect each piece without breaking it.

title: Unicorn Find The Differences
description: Unicorn Find The Differences is a magical spot-the-difference game designed to test your observation skills and bring a bit of fantasy into your day! Each level offers beautifully crafted images with subtle differences that make every game exciting and engaging. Perfect for both kids and adults, this game is a delightful way to relax, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy charming unicorn illustrations. See if you can spot all the differences and reach the next level of mythical fun!

title: Butterfly Match Mastery
description:
Plunge into the atmosphere of a magical forest in a new game in the style of Mahjong Connect. Free the butterflies by finding identical pairs of wings!

Butterfly Match Mastery is an amazing game that will give you moments of pleasure. Free butterflies in an enchanted magical forest by connecting pairs of identical wings and enjoy their flight! But don't forget about the time, when it runs out - you will lose.

title: Dress Up Run

Perfect for players searching “dress up game,” “fashion game,” or “makeover run,” this stylish challenge lets you become a fashion queen while racing through exciting levels. With princess vibes, outfit makeovers, and endless glam fun, Dress Up Runway is the best free fashion challenge for US teens and students!

title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d

title: Knife Master : Ball Racing

Chop chop chop, throw the knife, but don't hit the ball~!

Make quick decisions, aim carefully, and stay ahead to win. Smooth on mobile and desktop, easy to learn but challenging to master.

Enter the arena and fight for victory!

Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

- upgrade your skills
- get rare things for your home

- buy items for your home

- get rewards for your achievements

Sort colorful tiles by color, stack smart to create powerful combos, and think ahead before the board fills up. Each level adds new twists, requiring focus, memory, and clever planning. Stuck? description: Help Poopy, a mischievous (and slightly stinky) inmate, break out of a maximum-security prison! Navigate through hazardous cells, evade ruthless guards, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden paths to escape. But beware—one wrong move, and Poopy lands in solitary confinement!

title: Toka Boka Home Clean Up Design
description: A new family has just arrived in this town, and they're in desperate need of your assistance. This isn't just a helping hand mission; it's a home transformation and management simulator! You need to help them clean dust, clean the home, rearrange clothes, design the house, and repair damaged things.

title: Radiant Rush
description: Radiant Rush is a minimalist synthwave drifting game where you control only the car's steering—not its speed. Your goal is to complete increasingly challenging levels while collecting all the datacubes scattered throughout.

title: Road Race 3d
description: Road Race 3D is an exciting racing game that allows you to ride on a challenging track! You will experience the perfect combination of 3D racing and parkour. Use flexible operation and quick reaction to win every game! To draw a vehicle, a vehicle will randomly appear for you.

title: Planet Takeover
description: take command of your interstellar empire and set out to conquer the entire galaxy! Forge strategic alliances that can be either your greatest asset or, under the cover of darkness.

title: Jail Prison Van Police Game
description:
Get ready for action-packed gameplay! Take on the role of a police officer, drive the prison van, and ensure the secure transport of criminals in this exciting Police Bus Game

Immerse yourself in the intense world of law enforcement with the Jail Prison Van Police Game. Assume the role of a dedicated police officer tasked with transporting high-profile criminals in a specially designed prison van.

title: Evony The King's Return
description: Want to conquer the world? In Evony: The King's Return, step into a vast universe of war and zombie attacks. Command an army and use powerful weapons and guns to attack the enemy. Keep moving your soldiers, shoot digital doors, and expand your army! Keep shooting to get the gun. Face endless zombie waves with your shooting skills and unlock powerful weapons.

title: Pet Fall
description: You can move animals from side to side. You have to collect full horizontal lines to make them disappear. Some animals are frozen and must be released twice, some are locked in cages and cannot be moved. Use bonuses when necessary

title: DayCare Tycoon
description: Are you ready to build your dream business empire and be a great babysitter in this money tycoon simulator ? Dive into the world of daycare games and experience the joy of managing your own thriving idle tycoon games. From welcoming adorable babies to creating a safe and happy environment, this game offers everything you need to grow your daycare business into a successful venture.

title: Merge Flow
description: "Merge Flow"  is a casual puzzle game, by the board of 5*7 number squares and the bottom n +/- operators, each of the blocks have numbers, use the operator to make the number square +/-n, the same number will be combined into a +1 number, while obtaining the corresponding score. When the operators run out, the round ends.

title: Space Blast
description: Space Blast is a 2D game full of action arcade game where your piloting skills and strategic thinking are key to navigating relentless waves of meteors. Command a powerful spaceship equipped with advanced weapons and take on the challenge of protecting the galaxy from incoming threats.

title: Supermarket Cashier Simulator
description:
Practice being the best cashier in the supermarket. Become a mathematician by calculating and entering prices of grocery items and giving change to your customers. By playing you also improve your mathematical skills with the calculator in the game. This game is suitable to be played by adults or teenagers.

With the supermarket cashier game, you will improve your skills and concentration in calculating and also increase your level of accuracy.

title: Microplastics Feeding
description: Microplastics Feeding is a game about a hungry fish who is looking for its favorite food: plastic! Help the fish to eat all the plastic things in the ocean!

title: War State IO - Conquer Battles
description:
Welcome to ultimate strategy game that lets you improve your tactical skills and lead your troops to triumph! 

Lead your army, conquer enemy camps, and expand your territory in fast-paced battles filled with action and strategy.

Every decision matters — whether you’re attacking enemy strongholds or defending your bases, clever maneuvers are key to achieving victory.

title: Brainrot-A Difference Challenge
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Brainrot – A Difference Challenge, the ultimate photo puzzle game! Spot subtle differences between two eerily similar Italian "brainrot" images across a series of mind-bending levels. Each pair of pictures will challenge your focus, attention to detail, and visual memory. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: Merge Food Puzzle
description: Merge Food Puzzle is a synthetic puzzle game. What is different from ordinary match-3 games is that successful matches will not disappear and will generate higher-level food. The game has two modes: Merge BBQ and Merge Fruit. Merge BBQ has a variety of barbecues waiting for you to unlock, including corn, cauliflower, fish, squid, and more. Have fun!

title: Papas Burger Cook
description:
Cook and travel through amazing burger restaurants, discover delicious recipes, prepare tasty meals, and serve hungry customers in the best burger shop.
This is a crazy cooking game full of fast kitchen action, burger fever, and food madness. Papas Burger Cook - fun cooking simulation game.
Become the ultimate burger chef, master every recipe, and reach the highest rank in this exciting food cooking adventure.

title: ASMR Beauty Treatment
description: OMG! Our patient arrived with a dirty, pimply face and teeth problems. Help her take care of these issues and showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Beauty Treatment game. After completing the treatment, style our patient with the best outfit and makeup from our collections to create the perfect look!

title: Ink Inc Tattoo
description: Ink Inc Tattoo is a free online simulation game for boys played on PuzzleGame. In the game, you can experience the satisfaction of a tattoo artist drawing various artistic tattoos for clients. You need to draw the correct lines and colors to complete the image given by the customer. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable. Come and get a new entertainment experience.

title: Home Island
description:
Looking for a family adventure game? Try our Home Island: Family Pin free puzzle games about village life in paradise island! Pull the pin to solve the puzzle, follow the story and enjoy adventures on the island.
On the adventure for discovering the new island, a family cruise ship plane had to face an accident because of the bad weather. The father has gone missing, but the mother and their daughter luckily survived and got to a strange island.

title: Cat Match 3
description: Dive into Cat Match 3, the thrilling Match-3 puzzle adventure! Match, swap, and blast through vibrant levels filled with unique obstacles, epic power-ups, and explosive combos. Journey through enchanting worlds, unlock daily rewards, and conquer special events. Challenge friends on the leaderboard or team up in exciting tournaments. With increasing difficulty and endless puzzles, every swipe brings you closer to victory. Ready to start matching magic? Join the adventure today!

title: Pet Doctor Business Tycoon-Pet care game
description: Step into the world of animal care with Pet Doctor – Animal Hospital Simulator! Become a kind and skilled veterinarian as you treat adorable pets including cats, dogs, rabbits, and more. Use realistic medical tools to diagnose, clean wounds, check heartbeats, and perform surgeries. Each level brings new challenges where you must care for sick, injured, or pregnant animals in a friendly hospital environment.

title: GT Micro Racers
description: GT Micro Racers takes high-speed racing to a whole new scale! Control tiny but powerful GT-style cars as they speed through thrilling outdoor tracks made from everyday household objects. Race across books, cans, and wooden ramps in a sunlit backyard filled with grass, flowers, and playful obstacles. Drift through sharp turns, hit insane jumps, and outmaneuver rivals to claim victory

title: Mustang City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning night city graphics, transforming the city into a neon-lit spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Mustang City Driver offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

title: Line on Hole
description: Dive into the addictive world of Line of Hole! Start with simple lines, progress to complex patterns. Earn coins for each level, unlock vibrant backgrounds. Use hints when stuck, test your logic, and enjoy endless fun!

title: Dino Game
description: Play Dino Game online! An offline-style dinosaur run for 1–3 players. Jump cacti, dodge flyers, unlock dinos, and race for high scores. Dino Game brings the classic offline dinosaur run to life with fast, responsive gameplay and local multiplayer. Dash across an endless desert, jump over cacti, and duck under swooping dinos as the speed steadily climbs. Play solo to beat your personal best, or switch to 2-player and 3-player modes to race friends on the same device.

title: Sprunki Garden
description: Welcome to Sprunki Garden – a wild match-3 puzzle adventure inspired by the legendary Sprunki meme! Match colorful Sprunki characters across 100 hilarious levels filled with chaos, charm, and absurdity. Every move connects you with the bizarre Sprunki universe, where each character is weirder than the last. Get ready to swipe, match, and laugh your way through the most brainrotted garden ever!

title: Hammer Master－Craft & Destroy!
description: Do you want to relax and smash everything you see with a huge hammer? In this free casual 3D game we have successfully combined the mechanics of merging, crafting weapons, destroying objects, etc. Click "Play" & relieve your stress by breaking all around!

title: 3D Ball Balancer
description: 3D Ball Balancer is a fun 3D rolling ball game. Control the ball to roll on the floating bridge. There are obstacles all over the floating bridge, including broken bridges, ramps, single-plank bridges, etc. Not only do you have to control the direction of the ball, but you also have to control the speed of the ball. How far you can go? Have a try!

title: Candy Cascade
description: Click on groups of two or more candies to destroy them. You need to collect certain amount of different sweets on every level.  Wooden blocks, honey and jam should be cleared from the game field. If there is a key on the game field it should be dropped down. The moves are limited for each level. If you have hard time with a task you can use bonuses that can be received when you collect jam.

title: Merry Christmas Connect
description: 《Cute Animal Connect》is a classic puzzle game where you connect identical patterns to eliminate them and score points. It tests your observation skills and reaction speed, with simple yet addictive gameplay that appeals to players of all ages.

title: Bobblehead Ball
description:
Are you a guy who is a talented with skills and speed? If yes, let's score.

Bubblehead Ball is a thrilling and fast-paced football game where you can challenge your opponents and show your abilities. One more thing, all of our characters in game are not in football world.

title: Hidden objects: Lost Island 2
description: Discover an immersive adventure on a lost island full of secrets, mysteries, and ancient artifacts. Together with a charismatic explorer, you’ll find yourself deep in tropical jungles where a forgotten temple of an ancient civilization lies hidden beneath overgrown vines and trees. Every location is a handcrafted scene packed with hidden objects, puzzles, and clues about the mysterious past.

title: Farmer Pedro
description:
Get ready to till the soil and reap the rewards in Farmer Pedro!

In this charming 3D farming simulator, you’ll take on the role of Pedro, a humble farmer with a big dream - to build the most bountiful farm in the countryside. Start by driving your trusty tractor around the initial plot of land, harvesting a variety of crops like corn, tomatoes, carrots, and more.

As you grow and harvest your crops, you’ll earn cash that can be used to expand your farmland and unlock access to new crops.

title: Hidden Object Great Journey
description: “Hidden Object: Great Journey” is an engaging game that invites players to scour various themed levels for cleverly concealed items. With multiple modes, a lot of challenges, and a treasure trove of objects to find, this game promises endless fun for hidden object enthusiasts. Sharpen your observation skills and embark on a delightful search with every play!

title: Math Lava: Tower Race
description: Test your math skills under pressure in Math Lava: Tower Race, a fast-paced Roblox style web game where quick thinking and accurate answers are your keys to survival. Answer math questions correctly to build blocks beneath you, racing against opponents and rising lava. The faster and more accurate you are, the higher you climb!

title: Car Escape
description: Car Escape Game is an addictive and challenging puzzle game. It will help you train your brain. The operation of the game is very simple, move the horizontally parked cars to the left and right, move the vertically parked cars up and down, and finally drive the red fire truck to the rightmost exit of the parking lot and the game will be successful.

title: Burger Day
description: Burger Day is a fun and fast-paced arcade game that puts you in charge of a busy burger kitchen. Stack ingredients to serve up tasty orders as quickly as possible. Your speed and decision-making skills are tested as customer demands increase. Satisfy hungry customers to unlock fresh challenges and advance through exciting levels.

title: Merge Pixel
description:
Attractive characters in dot, pixel style!
Combining the same characters creates a higher level of characters.
Repeat Merge to create a legendary character.

title: Hit Knock Down
description: Hit & Knock Down is a fun casual game where you aim to throw baseballs. Shoot as many targets as possible. Test your precision, reaction speed, and throwing skills. You aim to hit the right targets in each level. The goals at the level are very varied, such as wood, stone, etc. Each level presents different targets. You should hit with a baseball.

title: Chroma Trek
description:
Dive into the glowing world of Chroma Trek, a vibrant neon platformer where every step is a test of skill and perception. With dazzling visuals and a unique color-switching mechanic, each level feels like a handcrafted puzzle filled with dynamic challenges.

Shift colors to phase through obstacles, stay sharp to dodge traps, and be inspired by motivational messages that guide you along the way. Your goal? Reach the shimmering Finish Crystal and conquer every stage with style.

title: Lazy Workers
description: The employees in the office have started slacking off and everyone is asleep. As the boss, you need to get the office back up and running. To do this, use your mouse and send employees to rows of desks. Move workers so they do not bump into each other. Your job will get a little more difficult with each level. If you cannot pass the level, you can use the option to skip the level.

title: Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles
description: Join a cosmic puzzle adventure where Tetriz meets pixel art. Place colorful Tetriz-style pieces on a grid to create shapes, ranging from easy to complex. Each piece has its own spot, adding to the challenge. Complete 45 levels, solving cosmic Tetriz puzzles in a space-themed setting. Can you beat this cosmic challenge before time's up?

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: SUIKA WATERMELON DROP
description: Engage, merge, and challenge yourself in this thrilling fruit-matching journey! Drop and collide identical fruits to evolve them, preventing them from falling out of the box. But here's the exciting twist: every time matching fruits collide, they transform into a completely new one. Can you keep merging your way up to the ultimate prize, the grand watermelon? The challenge awaits!

title: Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics
description: Hop on a plane and spend your winter vacation traveling around the world together with your favorite princesses. Discover fun winter activities and practice your fashion advisor skills while helping them choose their outfits of the day in the Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics for girls! Have a blast!

title: Wordler
description:
It's the same English word guessing game as Hackman I played when I was young.
You are given six chances to guess a word that consists of only five letters.
How many times can you get it right?

title: Hero Tower War
description:
Many monsters and enemies in the tower. You need to defeat them, get treasures and save hostages.

You can play everywhere ,every time. It is a boring killer game.

title: Bubble Around
description: Bubble Around is bubble shooter with a twist. You shoot the bubbles from the inside to the playing field around you. Match 3 or more bubbles to make them pop. Clear all bubbles to complete the level. Each level will be slightly more challenging. Stuck in a level? Use the bomb, rocket or multi color power up. Find out all level shapes!

title: Banana Bounce!
description:
Banana Bounce! ? is a side-scrolling game where you lead your banana to as far as you can.
Discover many cool ? and amazing ? powerups to boost ? your progress!
Discover unique ? characters and earn coins ? while you run!
Don't forget to upgrade ⬆️ your powerups to make them even stronger ? and better!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Block Merge City
description: Block Merge City is a relaxing isometric puzzle game where you place and combine buildings to evolve them into bigger structures. Strategically plan your moves, score high, and avoid running out of space!

title: Squid Game Memory Card Match
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game Memory Card Match! Test your memory and focus as you uncover pairs of iconic Squid Game symbols and characters. Can you keep your cool under pressure and match all the cards before time runs out?
Challenge yourself or compete with friends to see who can master the ultimate memory test. With Squid Game Memory Card Match, every flip brings you closer to victory or defeat – can you handle the pressure?

title: Chicken shooter io
description: SUPER COOL SHOOTER game, in which you will plunge into exciting fights with chickens, roosters and chickens. Your task is to choose the best equipment and make full use of your shooting skills to defeat other characters in this feathered battle!

title: Color Dots Challenge
description: Dive into Color Dots Challenge, a bright and addictive puzzle game that puts your logic and strategy to the test. Connect, match, and move colorful dots to clear the board and score big! Simple to play yet hard to master, this free online game is perfect for quick breaks or long sessions on your phone or computer. Can you outsmart the colors and conquer every level?

title: Race Clicker
description: Race Clicker is an action-packed idle clicker racing game that'll pump up your adrenaline. Customize, upgrade, and speed your way to victory. Each click pushes your limits, every upgrade unveils new possibilities, and each race dares you to click faster. Leave rivals in the dust and satisfy your need for speed with endless excitement. Start your engines and hit the track now!

title: Toca Teens Floating Beach Party
description: The Toca Teens are ready for the ultimate floating party—and they’re counting on your style sense! In Toca Teens Floating Beach Party, your goal is to get everyone dressed in their best summer-ready looks before the fun begins.

title: GTA: Grand Vegas Crime
description: Grand Vegas Crime is an open-world action game set in a sprawling city inspired by Las Vegas. Players take on the role of a daring gangster looking to rise through the criminal underworld. The game offers intense missions, thrilling car chases, and fierce shootouts against rival gangs and law enforcement. Grand Vegas Crime delivers an adrenaline-pumping experience filled with crime, action, and adventure.

title: Cube in Cube
description: Play the new 2048 game with unique mechanics! Develop strategies to clear cubes in endless mode or rescue the monkey. Challenge yourself now!

title: Magic Finger
description: Magic Finger 3D is a casual physics game where you use your magical powers to defeat alien foes creatively. Use your magic touch to throw enemies at each other, utilize explosive barrels for big impacts, and send adversaries off platforms. Control your surroundings by picking up and manipulating objects, becoming the ultimate magic user.

title: Slide Block Puzzle
description: Slide Block Puzzle is an addictive puzzle game. With no timer or pressure, every move is a calming and satisfying challenge for your brain. Solve color block puzzles, arrange blocks to escape from challenging boxes, a game that provides a fun and satisfying experience.

title: Love Colors
description: Dive into Love Colors, the ultimate relaxing coloring app! Transform this elegant Art Nouveau portrait of a graceful woman—adorned with swirling leaves and blooms—using lush reds, pinks, and light pinks. Effortless tools: zoom, undo, redo, and instant download. Unleash creativity, melt stress away!

title: Real Flight Simulator
description: Real Flight Simulator plays like an airplane driving simulation game with 3D models. In 6 levels, you can learn how to drive an airplane including starting, steering, and landing. All of the complicated instrument panels are simplified for players to learn. The more expensive the airplane you drive, the better acceleration of it you can enjoy including the Power, Speed, Solution, and Brake. Good luck in the sky!

title: Doodle Football
description: Doodle Football is an imaginative and captivating 2D casual game that combines creativity, strategy, and fun. Your goal is simple: guide the football into the goal while overcoming exciting challenges across a variety of themes like the lush greenery of fields, the scorching sands of the desert, and the frosty landscapes of ice.

title: Princess Run 3D
description: Want a magical and exciting running adventure? Step into Princess Run 3D, a fun 3D platform arcade game full of exciting challenges. Play as a fearless princess racing through colorful 3D worlds. Collect beautiful clothes, shoes, hair, etc. Increase your charisma to get a maid of honor. They're going to help you fend off enemies in front of you or dirty mud, rain, etc. Be careful to avoid ugly clothes, costumes, bad weather, etc.

title: Vortex io
description:
Play Vortex.io for free! Swallow everything in your path and become the biggest vortex in this fast-paced io game.

Vortex.io is a competitive .io game where you control a growing vortex that can swallow objects, vehicles, and even other players. As you absorb more items, your size increases, making you more powerful in the arena. The game features smooth controls and intense gameplay, requiring quick reflexes and smart movement to survive and dominate your rivals in real time.

title: Match 3D Puzzle Saga
description: Ready to match and collect? Solve puzzles to earn coins, unlock powerful power-ups and complete daily challenges to grab extra rewards and sweet bonuses. The more you play, the more opportunities you have to boost your score!

title: Popcorn Stack
description: Welcome to Popcorn Stack! Here, you will have a fun stacking popcorn trip. Collect many boxes and fill them with grain, sprinkle them with choco, bake and other food. Pack them up, cover them, and decorate them with fancy wings.

title: Rocket Sky!
description: In Rocket Sky! you tap and hold the screen to launch your rocket as far into the sky as you can. Make sure not to overheat though, otherwise it’s game over!

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Idle Pop Merge
description: Get ready for endless fun in Idle Pop Merge! Drag and drop characters into the slots to merge them into stronger versions. The more you merge, the more powerful your team becomes. It's a simple, addictive game that anyone can enjoy—whether you’re on desktop or mobile. Perfect for players who love puzzle challenges with a strategic twist!

title: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge
description: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge is an addictive merge puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merge games. This game is in 3D with crazy fun physics! The squares don't stay in place, they pop up. The gameplay is much simpler. If you like 2048 games and want to play a novel mode, join the game.

title: Hexa Sort 3D
description: Hexa Sort 3D mixes puzzle challenges, strategic matching and a satisfying merging experience.Involving clever puzzle-solving and logical manoeuvres, this game is ideal for those seeking a mental workout. As the levels progress, players will find the game both addictive and calming, striking the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Put your skills to the test with tasks such as sorting, stacking and merging hexagonal tiles.

title: Army Fight 3d
description: Begin the nervous army battles in Army Fight 3D. Here you need strategic thinking and quick reflexes.In this fun action battle game, you aim to build a powerful army. Defend your base, and defeat the enemy. Start by creating and upgrading your army.

title: Falling Art Ragdoll Simulator
description:
The harder they fall, the more points they get!

Jump in and enjoy the beauty of falling art! Because let’s be honest - there is nothing more satisfying than watching someone hurt themselves in the most dumb and ridiculous way. Especially when that someone is a 3d model with ragdoll physics and you don’t need to feel sorry for it at all!
 
Just enjoy our crazy game, have fun, and stay safe!

title: Chill Clicker
description: Chill Clicker is a clicker game where you multiply the Chill Capybara population by clicking. You can buy various upgrades to increase the output of Chill Capybaras, change the weather, and unlock new skins to make you the coolest Chill Capybara in town.

title: Griddlers Deluxe
description: Welcome to Griddlers Deluxe! Immerse yourself in a world of captivating puzzles. Uncover hidden images by deciphering numerical clues on the grid. With almost 200 challenges, Griddlers Deluxe offers addictive brain-teasing fun. Ready to decode the mysteries? Play now!

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Robbotto
description: Robbotto is an arcade platformer with a retro esthetic. Play alone or with a friend as you travel through the ship defeating all the enemies.

title: Wired Chicken Inc
