title: Crazy Bus Station
description: Embark on a thrilling puzzle adventure! Maneuver buses through challenging parking lots, match cars with their passengers, and clear the path. Unlock unique vehicles, tackle puzzles of all difficulty levels, and use boosters to sort or shuffle when needed. With vibrant graphics and creative gameplay, this game offers fun for players of all ages!

title: Money Factory - Earn a Billion
description: Prepare for a thrilling journey into the world of finance! As the owner of a money factory, you'll build and link mechanisms to boost your earnings with every step. Overcome exciting challenges where strategy is crucial to your success. Collect powerful boosters, create combos, and unlock new levels to discover even more ways to grow your fortune. Upgrade your factory to fast-track your rise to riches and become a financial powerhouse!

title: My City Hospital
description:
My City Hospital is a sophisticated digital doll placement game. Have you ever thought about being a doctor or running a hospital to help others? you can realize your dream without
leaving home. In this game, you run a large hospital with 7 management areas. In this hospital, you can help others deliver babies and take care of babies, examine patients, and help patients
with surgery.

title: The Roman Empire Colosseum
description: The war in the colosseum has never been as epic as in this game! Arrange your units and send them into battle! This online game is a battle simulator similar to Totally Accurate Battle Simulator. Your units include warriors, riders, titans, dwarves, mages, and more.

title: Fox Adventure
description:
Is a dynamic endless runner that brings back the spirit of classic arcade games!
Run or Lose! Control a brave fox in a world where danger lurks at every step. Fiery meteors rain down from the sky, and deadly spikes cover the ground. Your reflexes are your best weapon. Jump, dodge, and survive as long as you can!
Build Your Collection Grab gold coins along the way! Visit the shop to unlock unique looks: become a futuristic Cyber-Fox, put on a Clown costume, wear the Royal robe.

title: Dig a hole in Russia
description: It all started when Grandpa lost the keys to his old Soviet car somewhere in the yard. Armed with a shovel, you're now digging a proper Russian hole—deeper and deeper. Unearth valuable resources, upgrade your gear, level up your skills, and unlock new underground secrets. Who knows what lies beneath familiar soil? Just don’t forget why you started: without his keys, Grandpa’s not a legend—he’s just a grumpy old man!

title: Sort Games Challenge
description: Sort Games Challenge is a puzzle game. Here you can challenge yourself and choose from multiple modes, not limited to one. Your goal is to complete the mission within a limited time to pass the level. Dont underestimate this game, its still very difficult to pass. Come and challenge!

title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
description: Step into the world of ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang, where you take on the role of an adorable mukbang streamer! Get ready to indulge in delicious food, satisfy your cravings, and share the experience with your viewers in a cozy, interactive livestream. The more you eat and engage, the more you earn!

title: Burger Empire
description:
Welcome to Burger & Beans Cafe, the ultimate restaurant-management game where you cook juicy burgers, brew the perfect coffee, and build the eatery of your dreams!

• Serve Delicious Orders: Flip patties and pour lattes for hungry customers—fast!
• Earn & Upgrade: Collect coins to unlock chic new tables, comfy booths, and vibrant dining areas.
• Customize Your Space: Choose décor, layout, and special menu items to keep guests coming back.

title: Worm: Apple Quest
description:
Get Ready for Challenging Puzzles in Worm: Apple Quest!

In this captivating puzzle platformer, guide your worm to the legendary Golden Apple while navigating devious obstacles and perilous chasms. The secret to success? Mastering your worm's growing length.

Every apple you collect makes your worm longer, unlocking new paths - but beware! With greater length comes tougher control. One wrong turn and you might get stuck, ending your run.

title: Cards: Klondike Solitaire
description:
A classic card game known for its simple and fun mechanics. If you love solitaire games, then this game is just for you! A famous card puzzle game that is popular among players all over the world.
Perfectly relaxing!

title: Mini Games Relax Collection 2
description: Relax and take a mini-game tour! Mini Games: Relax Collection 2 brings you a series of casual and fun mini-games, designed for you to relax in your spare time! There are various types of games,each easy to play and extremely fun, allowing you to immerse yourself easily in the game world.

title: Arrow Sorting
description: Arrow! Sorting Food is a satisfying puzzle adventure where every move changes the board. Tap the arrows to unravel colorful fruit chains, clear paths, and untangle tricky patterns across countless levels. Unlock new visual themes, collect fun skins, and enjoy relaxing yet brain-teasing gameplay that grows more challenging with every stage. Simple to learn, surprisingly addictive to master!

title: Pin Master
description: Pin master: Screw puzzle quest & brain games challenges your problem-solving skills in a captivating pin puzzle adventure. Strategically tap to unlock screw holes on products, guiding metal plates to fall in the correct sequence. Navigate through intricate mazes of nuts, bolts, and plates. With each level presenting new challenges, immerse yourself in over 100 brain-teasing stages. Need a hint? No problem! Utilize the hint feature or remove random screws to progress.

title: Qube 2048
description: We present a unique arcade game that combines the dynamic gameplay of Q*bert and the mechanics of 2048!  You start with the number 2 and move across a grid of blocks, doubling its value. The goal is to reach the maximum number by planning your moves and avoiding obstacles.

title: G Wagon City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate busy morning streets, managing fuel and realistic traffic. Venture beyond the city to tackle rugged offroad terrain. Stunning morning graphics bring the city and landscapes to life, while unpredictable pedestrians and police chases add excitement. Customize your G-Wagon's look and performance, and enjoy the ride with your loyal dog. Whether evading cops or exploring trails, G-Wagon City Driver offers a thrilling experience.

title: Sticker Puzzle Book
description: Step into the captivating world of Sticker Puzzle, where creativity and strategy come together in a beautifully immersive experience. Explore a vibrant sticker book filled with artistic challenges, visual storytelling, and mind-bending puzzles. Designed as a peaceful chromatic retreat, Sticker Puzzle blends the calming satisfaction of sticker art with the engaging thrill of strategic problem-solving — the perfect harmony of relaxation and mental stimulation.

title: Find It Fast
description: Discover the ultimate hidden object game! Test your observation skills by uncovering hidden items in fun, challenging levels. Relax and enjoy this scavenger hunt adventure with stunning puzzles. Focus on listed items, tap to reveal hidden objects, and race against time to unlock vibrant maps. Explore interactive scenes, solve puzzles, and prove yourself as the scavenger hunt master! Enjoy free gameplay, endless entertainment, and thrilling challenges. Play now and see what you can FIND!

title: Anomaly Content Record
description: Welcome to Anomaly Content Record, a terrifying horror adventure where your only goal is to escape and survive. You’re a field investigator sent to explore a restricted research facility that went silent overnight.

title: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds
description:
Dodge and shoot to survive 15 seconds! Master 40 levels of arrow chaos in this fast-paced pixel art platformer! 

Dive into Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, a thrilling 2D pixel art platformer where every second counts! As a skilled archer, your mission is to survive 15 seconds per level by dodging deadly hazards and strategically firing arrows.

title: Fish Feeding
description: Nobody can stop you, but you are not the only fish in the sea: you will have to avoid the vicious sharks that wander in the deepest, darkest depths, looking for a nice little fish to eat! See how high you can score!

title: Dirty Money The Rich Get Rich
description: Dirty Money: The Rich Get Rich is a money clicker relaxation game. You are permitted to make money by tapping. When you earn some money and level up on the corresponding level, you can speed up by upgrading in the Growth, using the Invest, and making the Assets. The more money you make, the more functions you can unlock and use. I hope you will complete the target and make 100 million!

title: Stickman Rogue Online
description: Get ready for an exciting stickman adventure! You will enter an exciting survival battlefield.Fight nervous battles against increasing enemies constantly. Collect experience points and progress through endless waves of enemies. Each wave of enemies is more challenging, so be careful to upgrade your skills to survive! Collect energy boosters in battle to upgrade your stickman skills. Increase speed, increase attack or increase defense.

title: Obby Rescue Pin
description:
Obby Rescue Pin is a brain-burning, high IQ puzzle game that is especially addictive. How you pull the pins to rescue the Obby depends entirely on your logic and strategy!
Avoid Dangers: Navigate around bombs, ferocious animals, and deadly traps.
Outsmart the Room: Unlike simple rope rescue games, this experience focuses more on strategic adventures.
Help the Escape: Clear the path to help the Obby escape out of the dangerous room.

title: Kobolm Rescue
description:
Kobolm Rescue is a casual managment game about saving cute creatures from dangerous caves and building them a new home.

Manage your Kobolm Rescue Crew, search for sleepy Kobolms  in caves, collect materials, and build them a nice new home on the beach!

title: Car Dealer Idle
description: Ever dreamed of becoming a top Car Dealer? In Car Dealer Idle, you’ll manage your own vehicle business. Buy and sell cars, expand your showroom, and grow into a real tycoon. Make smart management decisions, upgrade your dealership, and watch your profits skyrocket. Unlock more booths to sell cooler vehicles. Unlock repair areas, test drive areas, etc.

title: Call of the Jungle! Animal Evolution
description:
Feel like the king of the jungle in this casual 3D runner about wild animals. Feed your hungry pet only the right food so that it develops. Collect crystals, level up your character and become the king of beasts in this free online game!

Dive into the exciting world of animals, where your pet will become a real king of beasts. In this exciting casual online game, you have to feed your animal so that it can grow and evolve. Go through exciting races and challenges in the wild jungle.

title: Horror School Detective Story
description: Ready to enter a horror school full of scares and mysteries? In Horror School: Detective Story, you’ll play the role of a brave detective. Solve the mysteries layered on top of each other at the school. Each scene is tense and exciting, full of suspense and the unknown! Choose the complexity of the scenario to start your challenge.

title: Gemstone Glam
description: Welcome to the fabulous world filled with sparkling gems! Here you will meet two princess girlfriends who adore fashionable outfits and the glitter of colorful stones in fashionable outfits. Try on dresses inspired by the radiance of a diamond, the passion of a ruby, the freshness of an emerald and the mystery of an amethyst. Create shining combinations of hairstyles, dresses and accessories to transform young princesses into real fashion queens. Feel like a real stylist of the jewelry kingdom!

title: Lorenzo the Runner
description: Lorenzo the Runner is a 2D Mario-like platformer that takes you on an exhilarating adventure through a vibrant cityscape The game features 4 levels set in 3 distinct environments. Bounce through the levels with slick controls and face a variety of enemies!

title: Halloween Stickman 2
description: It's a continuation of Halloween Stickman story. The streets are alive with people in costumes, glowing jack-o'-lanterns, and the buzz of tricks waiting to unfold. You were set to enjoy a thrilling Halloween night until your sly friend Stickman, the master of mischief, pulled another one of his classic pranks and set you up again. Now, it’s up to you to turn the tables, use your wits, and punish the trickster in this spooky adventure!

title: Geometry Flap
description:
Enter a world of bold outlines, sharp corners, and pure reflex. In Geometry Flap, you control a shapeshifting arrow darting through a black-and-white maze of geometric chaos. Tap to flap, weave through deadly gates, and dodge precision traps in this high-speed gauntlet of skill.

Features:
One mistake = instant crash.
Simple to play, brutally hard to master.
Unlock dozens of slick arrow skins.

Will you survive the rhythm of geometry?
Challenge your reflex. Flap to glory.

title: Chicken Jump : A Tap Challenge
description: This is simple but addictive chicken jump game. You'll have lots of levels and you have to save your chicken but swiping on screen from bottom to up to make chicken jump so that it can avoid hurdles.

title: Cube to Hole Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Cube to Hole Puzzle!
Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing experience! In Cube to Hole Puzzle, your objective is simple: fill the colored cubes into their matching colored holes. But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!

title: Scary Pairs
description: In the new exciting online game Scary Pairs you will have fun going through the levels of an interesting puzzle that is dedicated to Halloween. In front of you on the screen you will see a playing field on which a certain number of cards will be located. They lie face down and in one move you can turn over any two cards. Look at the images on them, because after a while the cards will return to their original state and you will make your move again.

title: Phrasle Master
description: Guess words of wisdom, proverbs and sayings in a fun brainteaser. Tap the words to make a phrase, and try to solve a riddle in 5 attempts using the color hints. As you progress, hidden phrases get longer, so you will need to apply all your logic and puzzle-solving skills to cope with the solve the riddles. Besides, such word games let you expand your vocabulary and learn foreign languages in a fun way. So, prove your skill as you decipher witty quotes and proverbs in a free word game online.

title: Bbq Stack Run
description: Enter a running arcade adventure filled with food and fun challenges. BBQ Stack Run takes you through the craziest BBQ-collecting parkour ever. Pick up various ingredients such as beef, chicken, sausage and more on the track as you run. Sprinkle them with barbecue seasoning and cook them through.

title: Royal Crown Blast
description:
Royal Crown Blast is a colorful and relaxing casual puzzle game where you tap, blast, and clear vibrant blocks to complete each level’s goals.
Immerse yourself in a royal atmosphere as you match groups of blocks of the same color and shape, triggering spectacular explosions and powerful boosters.
With many levels, charming visuals, and simple one-tap controls, the game is both relaxing and delightfully addictive.

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

title: Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends
description: Welcome to Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends. Hello little girls. Are you ready for the latest spring fashion collection? Follow the latest fashion trends with these celebrities and create your own fashion clothes for next spring season. Browse their wardrobe to pick suitable outfits and costumes. Join and help them to welcome their favorite season.

title: Color Block Blast 3
description:
Drag and drop the correct block into the grid. Match 3 or more tiles of the same colour to eliminate them.

Score beautiful combos while earning bonus points and watching beautiful animations take shape.

How high can you score in this endless match 3 game?

title: Summer Rider 3D
description: Hit the waves in Summer Rider 3D, a sun-soaked surf adventure inspired by high-speed endless runners. Glide over water on a surfboard or jet-ski, collect shimmering starfish, and push your reflexes to the limit as the speed cranks up. With a colorful summer theme and upbeat tropical soundtracks, the game offers endless fun for both solo and 2 player mode!

title: Save Her Tour
description: This complex and relaxing puzzle game you've read about has finally become a reality! Only the smartest can pass these brain teaser quizzes and save the girl! Each level will give you a scenario where you must use your ingenuity to solve the problem. If you mess up, it won't end well for our heroine. There are so many different challenges waiting to be solved. This is the best puzzle game ever! Solve interesting puzzles, protect the girl from harm, and experience the thrill of success.

title: Mahjong Connect Fish World
description: Mahjong Connect Fish World is a captivating puzzle game with an ocean theme. In this beautiful underwater world, players need to connect matching mahjong tiles to eliminate them, unlock levels, and explore a rich variety of marine creatures. The game combines traditional connect-style gameplay with an ocean theme, providing players with a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Russian Fishing at Sea
EvoWars.io
description: EvoWars.io is an IO battle game set in a top-down online battle arena. Collect orbs and battle other players to evolve your warrior.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Wednesday Light Academia
description: Join the trend in Wednesday Light Academia - a fun, immersive makeover game for girls! Today you're becoming a super-talented stylist and your job is to transform Wednesday Addams from a dark e-girl look to a stunning girly-girl fashionista. Explore the fun realms of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion-forward wardrobe choices with this addictive game. Have fun!

title: Bouncing Chick
description: In Bouncing Chick you have to reach your nest as fast as you can, avoiding obstacles and hazards. Go to the top of the level and try to beat your record! There are 24 levels to beat, so what are you waiting for? Start your climbing to the top!

title: Upside Down
description:
Upside Down is a puzzle platformer game in which you must control the character, gather all of the stars and keys, and complete all of the levels.

The levels are difficult and mental exercises. In order to finish the levels, you have to switch between two distinct worlds. The lovely graphics and calming soundtrack make the game enjoyable and lovely. Go through the portal, leap, run, get away, and enjoy yourself.

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: Zombie Space Episode II
description: There has been an outbreak of a zombie virus on a space station. The first group of mercenaries has disappeared. Your task is to find survivors among the zombies and find out the cause of the zombie apocalypse. You will have to fight with a horde of zombies, using different types of weapons. Look for hidden weapons in chests. Upgrade characters and weapons! Use your characters' abilities in heated battles against zombies. Play with a friend on the same device or alone!

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: Draw Bridge Challenge
description: Drag to create a path and guide the car to the goal! You can only draw the line once, be careful not to break the car! To become a good bridge builder, you just need to drag with one finger to draw a bridge that is stable enough for the car to reach flags. You can draw a bridge on only one line, so make sure safety comes first.

title: VSCO Girl Aesthetic
description: Welcome to the VSCO Girl Aesthetic. Rainbow High school girls Sunny, Skyler, Ruby, and Violet are the trendy fashion girls. They planned to try VSCO fashion which is trending all over social media. Join and browse their wardrobe to pick some suitable outfits for the girls. Play and Have fun!

title: Earthquake io
description: Earthquake io is a realistic 3D physics-based disaster simulator in which you take control of the forces of the Earth to destroy cities, destroy buildings and crush all small objects to compete with other players in a fierce battle.

title: Throne vs Balloons
description: In this unique and dynamic game, your attention and dexterity will be put to the test when you control a bouncing ball and use its sharp spikes to break through obstacles and pop balloons.

title: Crown & Cannon
description: Crown & Cannon is a fast-paced 2D strategy game where players expand territory, deploy various weapons, and battle dynamic AI on destructible terrain. It features upgradeable units, strategic combat, and is optimized for Web platforms and cross platform.

title: Asylum: Baldi Granny Slender
description: You'll be heading into the forest to find a mental hospital. Legend has it that this mental hospital is where rare Brainrot figurines are found. Characters like Baldi, Granny, and Slenderman guard these figurines. A bipedal deer also lives in the forest, so be careful not to fall into their clutches! You can hide under beds in the mental hospital to avoid being caught by the monsters.

title: Witchy and the Puzzle Adventures
description: Help the brave Witch to pass all the puzzling tests and find all the seals to shelter them in her cozy forest house. Kittens are lost in the forest, which is full of various traps and dangers, you need to help the Witch to pass all the tests and find all the seals.

title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
description: Zombies have taken over the world! Unlock bases and deploy soldiers with unique weapons, each with stats like damage, fire rate, and reload speed. Soldiers must reload at the base before defending. Place them wisely to stop zombies within range. Defeat waves to earn coins, upgrade bases, and survive stronger hordes. Strategically choose soldiers to clear waves and save cities across the globe.

title: Relay Race
description: Relay race game is an engaging and addictive game that combines puzzle solving elements, casual gameplay and exciting race challenges. This game offers players a unique combination of fun puzzles and trolls for a thrilling and engaging gaming experience.

title: Head Jump
description: run, jump, and climb to avoid direct collisions. Head Jump is a casual game, with a very fast runner forcing you to have a quick response to avoid obstacles, beautiful music will make you addicted to playing this game, difficult levels will stimulate tension and challenge adrenaline, complete each level to continue to improve your playing skills.

title: Cat Snack Bar
description: Embark on a unique cat simulator and restaurant adventure where your passion for food meets the charm of feline companions. Cat Snack Bar blends food preparation and cat management into an engaging tycoon experience.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Drive Ahead Sports
description: Want to begin a pixelated sports showdown like no other? In Drive Ahead! Sports, you’ll be behind the wheel of amazing vehicles, engaging in exciting soccer matches! Enjoy the rush of driving and the fun of the game! Use your skills to kick the ball, attack the opponent's goal, and aim for victory!

title: Idle Factory Empire
description:
Make sure those boxes are shipped FAST!

Click on factory buttons to upgrade your productivity. Earn cash and reinvest to upgrade your factory production.

Be sure to earn extra bonuses from balloons and drones.

Follow the advice of the IT guy and engineer to crank those profits UP.

Oh, and did we mention that your money is piling up as we speak? Go offline, return and claim profits.

title: Solitaire Home Story
description: Solitaire Home Story is a puzzle card game where you play through multiple levels of the solitaire card game, which helps you unlock home renovations as you slowly unfold the dramatic story set in the town of Brook's End.How to Play Solitaire Home StoryYou play as Alice, who has just returned to her childhood home with her friend Tara, a few years after her mom passed away, only to find the place in terrible shape.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Digital Circus IO
description:
Grim AI gathered amazing creatures at the circus arena and offered them the chance to compete for life here!
Pick your character and get as much territory as you can! Run from your starting territory and return to add a chunk of space. Evade other characters or defeat them by stepping on their trail.

title: Koi Fish Pond - Idle Merge Game
description:
An addictive idle merging game. Build your own Koi fish company and grow your business.
Release your Koi fishes into the pond and earn money every time they cross the finish line. Buy new Koi fishes (or collect them from the gift boxes), and merge the same level Koi fishes to upgrade into a new type. The higher-level of the Koi fishes, the more money you will earn. Use your earnings to buy upgrade packages in the Shop to help you make money faster!

title: Word Wipe
description: Word Wipe is a word search puzzle game where you connect letters to form words and clear them from the grid. Form words by combining letters, causing them to vanish and creating new letter combinations as others drop down.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Number Master Run And Merge
description: Number Master: Run And Merge is an awesome number racing game that lets you run, merge, and upgrade on a parkour platform to become a true number master! Control your number character as you run through dynamic tracks. Keep collecting more numbers and expanding. Merge with matching numbers to grow stronger. The bigger your number, the more unstoppable you become! Pick the smartest paths, hit speed zones, and keep your speed maxed out!

title: Dice Fusion
description: Dice Fusion is a casual game with puzzle content. The game is easy to understand and use the game mechanism, as well as highly strategic gameplay, colorful vision and with a leisurely background sound, to bring users visual and auditory dual enjoyment, so as to achieve the relaxation of the user's physical and mental needs.

title: Basket Sport Stars
description: A great basket challenge begins with random characters and with random basketball arenas with the Basket Sport Stars game! Play single or 2 player! The game consists of many levels, characters, and various game modes like Tournament, Quick Matches, 2 player Matches, and Practice Matches. You can play any of these modes for free, without unlocking. Pick most of the characters for free and start shooting your opponent's basket hoop!

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: Snake Clash
description:
Fast-paced and Exciting free-run Snake PvP Gameplay.

Play as a snake and collect points to grow longer. Avoid the deadly tiles or use the snake body to break the tiles in your way! But watch out, because the snake will shorten as you use points. Quick decisions are key!

Compete with a different opponent in each battle.
Grow your snakes, avoid Skull Tiles and collect Battle Points to climb the daily leaderboard and be the One to claim the Snake Clash Crown.
Game on!

title: Triple Tile Twister Match Game
description: Triple Tile Twister: Match Game is a relaxing puzzle with a twist on mahjong. Clear the board by matching groups of three identical tiles. ?✨ Strategically select tiles to move to the holding area, which holds up to 7 tiles. Create sets of three to clear them, but watch out! ? If the area fills with unmatched tiles, the game ends. Enjoy soothing graphics and relaxing gameplay—perfect for unwinding! ? Great for both mahjong fans and newcomers! ?

title: Arcade Rope
description:
Swing between platforms in Arcade Rope! Play free and online in this rope-swinging adventure.
Arcade Rope is a fast-paced and addictive skill game where your goal is to swing from platform to platform using a rope. Perfectly time your swings to avoid falling into the abyss and see how far you can go. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, making it ideal for quick play sessions. Stay alert, react quickly, and master the art of swinging to survive longer.

title: Slope Spooky
description: Slope Spooky is a Halloween-themed! A ball rolling down difficult and eerie slopes is controlled by the players. It's almost Halloween, which means Slope needs some scary stuff!

title: Chain Puzzle
description: Chain Puzzle is a relaxing logic game where you carefully untangle intricate chained constructions. Each construction is a single system of two same-colored balls connected by a chain. Every move changes the shape of the structure: the chain can automatically shorten, opening new ways to solve the puzzle. Observe, adjust positions, and find the right sequence of actions to completely unravel the knot.

title: Agent Hunt: Spy Shooter Game
description: Step into the role of an elite hitman in this tactical first-person shooter. Complete covert missions with precision shooting, stealth infiltration, and strategic planning. Use advanced sniper weapons to eliminate targets across diverse environments from cities to enemy hideouts in this action-packed spy thriller.

title: Fun IQ Puzzle
description: Fun IQ Puzzle is a vibrant and engaging logic game that test your problem-solving skills with colorful bubble-based puzzles. In Story Mode, we have to unlock locked spaces by placing colorful puzzles in the right spots. In Time Attack Mode, we have to race against the clock to solve puzzles as quick as possible. Challenge yourself to master every stage with this fun puzzle game!

title: Tower Guardian - Epic Defense
description:
- Strategically summon warriors and unleash devastating abilities to protect your tower from hordes of enemies!
- Fight off waves of monsters, unlock new levels, and upgrade your heroes as you rise to become the ultimate protector. Every wave gets tougher—only the strong and strategic will survive.
- Rotate around the tower, lock onto approaching foes, and eliminate them before they breach your defenses! 
With each wave, enemies grow stronger and more numerous.

title: 3D Maze Control
description: 3D Maze Control is a casual and fun puzzle physics game. Your goal is to rotate the board to let the ball reach its goal. The ball always falls down due to gravity and beware of scary aliens on the way.

title: Tropical Match
description: Embark on a vibrant adventure in Tropical Match 3! Help Coco, your lively island guide, find fruits and other island gems in a tropical paradise. Match exotic fruits, uncover vibrant flowers and observe colourful exotic birds while enjoying the island adventure. The game features exciting levels and a relaxing island soundtrack! So what are you waiting for? Enjoy the tropical paradise adventure now!

title: Candy Crunch: Sugar Escape
description:
Candy Crunch is a puzzle game where players move colorful block shapes to matching exits.

Each level challenges you to slide and reposition tightly packed blocks with different shapes and colors.

New obstacles appear as you progress, keeping gameplay fresh yet easy to understand. Levels are short, intuitive, and designed for quick, casual sessions.

With smooth controls and relaxing puzzles, Candy Crunch is perfect for logic and problem-solving fans.

title: Mini Golf Saga
description: Embark on an immersive golf adventure with Mini Golf Saga, a captivating 3D mini-golf game set against the backdrop of a picturesque beach, featuring diverse golf levels where precision is key to achieving the lowest hit count for a high score; facing limited hits per level, strategize your shots wisely and, when needed, watch a rewarded video ad to replenish your chances and continue the saga of sun-soaked golfing excitement.

title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
description: Immerse yourself in a game where the process of coloring becomes truly meditative. Create and decorate houses as a designer. Just touch the screen and the colors will match the numbers in the image. Forget about boring routine - now you are thinking about color combinations. For even more relaxation, a music player has been added.

title: Turbo Trucks Race
description: Turbo Truck Race, an intense racing game with diverse trucks, unique abilities, and action-packed modes. Experience the adrenaline with realistic graphics, strategic gameplay, and the freedom to explore different landscapes in FreeMap mode. Turbo Truck Race brings a new level of excitement with powerful trucks!

title: Word search
description:
A beautiful word puzzle game with challenging yet addictive features for hunting down the words you love! Train your brain in a fun and relaxing way and take your critical thinking skills and IQ to the next level.
Find all the words on a given topic. Words are arranged horizontally, vertically, diagonally, and may overlap.

title: Card Battle

With its engaging graphics and fun gameplay, Donut Box is perfect for players looking for a light and enjoyable gaming experience.
Try Donut Box today and enjoy a sweet and engaging gaming experience!

title: Romantic Match Tactics
description: Romantic Match Tactics" invites you into a charming world where love meets strategy. Immerse yourself in an enchanting puzzle adventure as you strategically clear the grid, saving moves, and mastering the key to success – a delicate balance between item movement and unlocking the locked items. Progress through 48 levels, each unveiling new challenges as you align romantic trios to triumph.

title: Ragdoll Parkour Simulator
description: "Ragdoll Parkour Simulator" is an adrenaline-fueled parkour game that challenges players to navigate through urban environments with precision and style. With improved graphics and mechanics, players can expect an even more immersive experience than its predecessor.

title: Grass Defense
description: Grass Defense is a strategic tower defense where you must protect the wilderness from waves of fierce creatures. Build and upgrade powerful towers, manage resources, and adapt your tactics as enemies grow stronger. With dynamic environments, diverse foes, and challenging levels, you’ll test your strategy and skill to survive the untamed wilds and uncover hidden mysteries.

title: What's The Difference?
description: What's The Difference? is a casual Spot the Difference game where you must find differences in two similar images.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Melon Drop: Fruit Merge Master
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! ??? When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: Farm Ring Idle
description: Farm Ring Idle is a circular farming simulation that challenges you to expand outward from a tiny central plot into a thriving, automated ring of crops. Grow vegetables, unlock smart upgrades, and deploy robotic helpers to streamline your harvest.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: ASMR Nail Treatment
description: Today's patient is dealing with thickening of the fingernails. Help her maintain good nail hygiene by providing proper nail care. Showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Nail Treatment game. Once the treatment is done, dress her in fashionable outfit and create captivating nail art using various styles and accessories.

title: Dear Island
description:
Collect two blocks that match the color of the Match Slot to clear them!
Clear them all to finish the stage!
Blocks of different colors can be placed in the Stock.
If the Stock gets full, it’s game over!

title: Pop Party - Suika Watermelon
description:
Get ready for Pop Party, a fast-paced 2D physics puzzle game with a wild twist! 
Your goal? Merge them to create bigger, better versions before your jar overflows! 

Power-Up the Madness!
Turn the tide of the game with six powerful abilities:
Shake
Level Up
Level Down
Claw
Bomb
Color Bomb

Unlock Stunning Themes!
Progress through the game and collect unique themes, each transforming the look of your balls:

Can you master the chaos, merge your way to victory, and unlock every theme?

title: Party Animals Cats Evolution
description:
**Gameplay:** Creating a cat has never been easier!  Just click on identical kittens, connect them together and get new types!  Go through all the stages of cats evolution and populate the planet with Party Animals!
Cats themselves generate coins - use them to buy additional cats, or boosters to improve the game!

**Content:** Discover 21 unique and cute party animals, each with a name as distinctive as their personality and a wonderful description that brings out their individual charm.

title: Makeup Fruits
description: In Makeup Fruits, give your favorite fruits a stunning makeover! Apply makeup, add accessories, and create fabulous fruit beauty icons. Choose from a variety of makeup options, including powder, lipstick, and eyelashes. Take a "selfie" of your creation and share it with friends! Earn gems to unlock even more fun items and keep the transformation going!

title: Impostor Among Space
description: Impostor Among Space is a thrilling single-player stealth game where you play as the Impostor aboard a spaceship full of unsuspecting AI crewmates. Your mission? Eliminate them one by one, sabotage critical systems, and avoid detection at all costs.

title: Bento Match
description:
Slide the blocks to line them up straight and clear them!
If there’s space, you can move multiple blocks at once.
You can also move blocks without clearing them, but you’ll lose 1 life.
Earn coins based on your score and use them to collect new blocks!
Collected blocks will appear randomly in the game—rare blocks give higher scores!

title: Block Breaker
description: Embark on a 2D adventure filled with dynamic physics! Break ice blocks, use springs and portals, and launch the character through the air to reach the goal platform. Master the environment and discover all the creative ways to complete each level!"

title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
description:
Become a legendary kunai master in this thrilling combination of dynamic gameplay and classic ninja action. Play offline and enjoy the freedom to dive into the adventure whenever you want. Slice through foes, overcome obstacles, and set out on an epic ninja quest without boundaries.

Will you seize the blade and claim your place as the ultimate ninja warrior?

title: Word Scramble - Family Tales
description: Want a distraction from the annoyances of daily life, or is your brain tired of solving exactly the same problems? Welcome to Word Scramble: Family Tales! Train your gray matter by solving word search puzzles and level up your vocabulary! An exciting family adventure, colorful locations and engaging play make this game hard to tear yourself away from. The story of a long-awaited child finally arriving in a family will come to life literally in front of your eyes.

title: Rescue Sharp Turn
description: Rescue Puzzle 3D is a lightweight 3D fun puzzle game. You need to click on the correct objects in the small three-dimensional scene to trigger mechanisms, remove obstacles or form a chain reaction to meet the level conditions and rescue the injured character. The levels are short but full of ingenuity: turn off the power switch, move rocks, release water to extinguish fire, synthesize props...

title: Paint Rush
description: White houses are boring. Bring the colors in and paint everything in seconds. Complete every level painting all white spaces. Swipe left, right, up and down and fill all the empty spots on Paint Rush

title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
description: Designed for those who love ball games with realistic physics and elements, the goal of this game is to roll to the finish line without falling into the water. Master the control of the ball and collect coins on your route to unlock new balls, tail tracks and sky packages. You can play the game in 1 player mode or 2 player racing mode. Enjoy realistic nature, physics and effects in dozens of different levels!

title: Going Balls 3D
description: Going Balls 3D is a relaxing 3D rolling game where smooth control and calm focus are the key to winning. Swipe to steer the wooden platform and guide the ball forward—no need to rush, just keep it steady and reach the finish line without falling.

title: Cyber Monday
description: Cyberpunk Monday thrusts you into a neon-drenched arcade cyberpunk adventure. Hack terminals, dodge digital foes, and race across futuristic CityGrid zones. Look for combos, outsmart AI, and collect cyber credits in this fast-paced hacking runner. Perfect for fans of cyberpunk games, arcade game thrills, free mobile games, and even cool math games that students love. Gear up—your Monday just got cyber.

title: Chess Duel
description: Master the art of chess with three exciting modes, each offering flexible time settings to suit every player. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Demolition Derby Derby
description: Welcome to Demolition Derby the mobile sensation where you control the chaos! Strategically tap to toss dynamite and swipe to send rocks crashing down. Decimate buildings and statues with precision in this hyper-casual game.

title: Tidy Master Satisfeel ASMR
description: Looking for a relaxing yet satisfying game experience? Tidy Master - Satisfeel ASMR is here to deliver pure organizing joy. This addictive casual game lets you step into beautifully designed scenes where you tidy up and become a true organizing master. With multiple modes to explore - classic, outdoor, indoor, and even food-themed - you’ll find yourself cleaning up beaches, gardens, and more. Start organizing now and become the ultimate tidy master!

title: Wild West Match
description: Embark on a captivating Wild West adventure with Bonnie! Explore iconic landscapes, face challenges, and uncover secrets in this thrilling journey. The frontier spirit awaits – join Bonnie on the quest for an unforgettable adventure!

title: Beat Music Battle
description: Step into the world of Beat Music Battle: 456 Survival, where rhythm meets creativity and fun! This casual music game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and party lovers alike.

title: Squid Game Hunter
description: Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game – a fast-paced game for stealthy and strategic players that takes you on a wild adventure as a hunter with a deadly knife. With multiple Squid games enemies to kill, challenging missions to complete, and rewards to collect, this game will test your skills and keep you on the edge of your seat.

title: Count Masters Superhero
description: In Count Masters: Superhero, begin an interesting parkour adventure like no other! As a superhero,you're constantly running, jumping, and avoiding obstacles throughout the level. Such as avoiding rotating mace, cutting machine and so on.

title: Destination Brain Test
description: Destination Brain Test is a great puzzle game to text your brain. You only need to drag to launch the ball to destroy all the blocks with various shapes. The farther you go, the more difficult levels you will meet. Luckily, you can try countless times in this game. So, try to challenge it now!

title: Bolts and nuts
description:
The game Bolts and Nuts is a logic puzzle? in which you have to unscrew bolts from planks?! Your task is to choose the right bolt to unscrew? so that you can unscrew all the planks ✌!
Compete with friends and colleagues ?!

title: Supermarket Shopping For Kids
description: Have you ever dreamed of owning your own supermarket? In this casual supermarket simulator game, you can make your dream come true! In our Supermarket Shopping For Kids game, you can not only enjoy shopping but also play as a cashier and check out items! Apart from that, there are also many fun mini-games you can join in the supermarket.

title: Basketball Rush
description: This isn’t just about shooting — it's about precision, patience and strategy. As you score, the game intensifies, but with helpful power-ups at your disposal, you’ll be ready for anything. Unlock a variety of unique ball skins to customize your game and add even more excitement.

title: Veck.io
description: Veck.io is a 3D multiplayer FPS IO shooting game with nonstop action among players across the globe. Players can compete in arcade mode, team battles ranging from 1v1 to 4v4, or fast-paced Gun Game challenges.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Tralala La La La italiano
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure! In this game you will have to connect Italian animals. Collect a collection of rare animals, discover new species and create your own virtual zoo!

title: Arrow Escape: Puzzle
description:
“Arrow Escape: Puzzle” is a logic puzzle where arrows block each other, and your goal is to untangle routes and clear the level by choosing the correct move order.

- Short levels you can play in a minute.  
- Focus on logic and move order, not speed.  
- Simple controls: one tap — one move.

title: Typing Adventure
description: Get ready for a fast-paced typing challenge in Typing Adventure! Type the words above each enemy to defeat them before they get too close. The longer you survive, the faster they come! How long can your fingers keep up? Battle endless waves and test your speed in this thrilling typing survival game!

title: ASMR Beauty Homeless
description: One of our patrons came in today with her homeless friend, Anna, who is in need of urgent hygiene care. Let’s assist the doctor in cleaning her body, teeth, and the area around her piercing. After the treatment, style her in the best outfit!

title: Pet Salon 2
description: Take care of the cutest puppy and cat that you can bathe, help it when it is sick and choose an outfit  and dress it up! Pet Salon 2 is very helpful for the daycare of your pet and have too much fun with this game.

title: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw
description: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw is a funny puzzle game with the most popular meme characters. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Granny GTA Vegas
description: Granny GTA Vegas drops the infamous horror legend into the heart of sin city! Armed and unhinged, Granny escapes her haunted house and brings chaos to the neon streets of Las Vegas. With red-hooded masked enemies hot on her trail, she must shoot her way through crime-ridden alleys, casino districts, and the Vegas Strip.

title: Pirate Paradise
description: Pirate Paradise is a fun and relaxing game where you have to match three identical items in a row. Help the pirates sort the items into portals. The difficulty of the game will gradually increase and there will be more and more items.

title: Circle Run Endless
description: Circle Challenge is an endless game, you need to keep the circle not touch the line. Collect the gifts and using it to buy the circle in the shop.

title: ASMR Washing & Fixing
description: This game is one of the cleaning games that gives you a real experience like no other. Most of the cleaning and organizing games on the market are 2D, but this game brings you a 3D experience. At the beginning of the game, you can pick a cool tool. There are 5 levels in this game and you can pick a level to start your cleaning. You can move your position as well as use the cleaning tool by clicking on the buttons on the screen or by hitting the keyboard.

title: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY
description:
Style Anna’s outfits and bring her fairy tale story to life!

Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY takes you into a magical world of creativity and fashion! In this charming paper doll game, you’ll help Anna dress up for a variety of occasions, from costume parties and romantic dates to festive holidays like Halloween and Christmas.

title: Deep in the Lab - Chapter 1
description: Deep in the Lab is 2D '90 style survival horror game, with old style pre-rendered backgrounds, puzzles to solve, keys to collect, monster to avoid or defeat (your choice), poor resources, jumpscares, limited saves, FMV and a five floors lab to explore.

title: Cosmo Pet Starry Care
description: Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of space and get to know cute alien creatures better. Choose your pet and find out how best to take care of them. Feed, walk and play with your space friends to give them happiness and care. Support your pets so that they please you with their devotion and love.

title: Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown
description:
Accept the challenge of the post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take on contracts, earn money and reputation, and collect valuable loot.
Survival belongs to those with the fastest ride and the biggest gun.

title: Brawl Stars
description: Welcome to a multiplayer arena game! Brawl Stars will take you into a world full of action .io battles! You will experience nervous PVP battles and a unique evolution system. Choose your favorite hero including fire dragons, electric dogs or flower spirits.

title: Connect Clues - The Missing Professor
description:
A tangled detective story is about to unfold.

Inspector Hale and Detective Crane are on the trail of a mysteriously vanished professor of history and archaeology — who also happens to be Crane’s old friend.
Professor Eldridge was always a touch eccentric, but disappearing without a word and leaving his office turned upside down was never part of his habits. He’s clearly in trouble — and in need of help.

title: Real Street Fighter 3D
description: Real Street Fighter 3D have very addictive game-play and many missions. In this you have to fight with other enemies and have to complete mission. It has many addictive missions.

title: Body Care Simulator
description: ASMR Cleaning is a fun simulation game on yad.com. There are four sections: foot spa, manicure, lip care, and clean inside the ear. You will enter a quiet and comfortable environment and experience different care processes. Have fun!

title: Cosmo Void
description: Enter the dazzling void of space where only sharp reflexes and split-second decisions can lead you to victory. Cosmo Void is a high-speed action runner where your space journey becomes more intense with every level. Face shifting obstacles, sudden turns, and blinding speed as you pilot your cosmic vessel through an ever-evolving space labyrinth.

title: Fish Master: Go Fish
description:
You’d think that a game called Go Fish would be based on the classic card game, but you’d be wrong. Fish Master – Go Fish is all about taking your ship to the middle of the sea and fishing until your boat can’t hold any more fish!

There are dozens of different fish types in the sea, and it’s your job to reel them all in! As you catch fish, your library of fish types will fill up, so you’ll always know what’s left to catch.

title: Three Chickens
description:
Hurry up! The chickens are coming home to roost.

Drag and drop the chicken into the tiles to match them.

Match 3 or more chickens to eliminate them.

How high can you score in this endless match 3 game?

title: Fruit Catcher
description:
Catch as many fruits as you can before they fall! ?
Move your basket left and right to collect fresh fruits and avoid rotten ones. Each fruit gives you points — how high can your score go?
This fun and colorful game tests your reflexes and speed. Perfect for kids and casual players who love simple but addictive gameplay!

title: Merge Archer Defense
description: Merge Archer Defense is an archery game focused on castle defense. Are you prepared to fight for your king? Meld archers to create a formidable stickman archery team and battle to safeguard your fortress. Don't hesitate for another moment. Rise to the top as a merge master, vanquish the army of archers, and ascend as the greatest archery hero!

title: Art Master Origins
description:
ART MASTERS: ORIGINS - COLORING BOOK is a educational painting game. It is a combination of color by numbers mechanics, with polish artists artworks to discover and the epic atmosphere of RPG games.

USP:
• Relax and feel like a real artist coloring by numbers every artwork to create legendary paintings! 
• Fulfill collection of painting’ trophies of every art trend!
• Distinguish a falsificate from a real work!

title: Traffic Run Puzzle
description: Traffic Run Puzzle is a popular car merge and racing simulator game. All Players can enjoy this game free online. Buy cars to merge, high-level cars can earn more money. Take it to the road to race, and watch out for other cars. Classic game-playing mode and car-driving content. Dear traffic cop, come to help them get through the intersection!

title: Magic Flow
description: Magci Flow are puzzle series solved by transferring liquids. Players must strategically use container capacities to sort liquids in the fewest moves. Tasks include merging same-colored liquids or precise sequencing, rigorously testing judgment skills.

title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
description:
A fast, fun twist on classic Onet puzzles!
Get ready to match and relax with Mojicon: Emoji Connect – the cheerful tile-linking puzzle bursting with personality!
Connect identical emoji tiles, clear the board, and enjoy satisfying spark effects with every perfect match.
With hundreds of cute icons, calming backgrounds, and rewarding combos, Mojicon delivers endless relaxing fun for all ages.
Play anywhere, anytime – no downloads, just pure emoji joy!

title: Flight Sim Air Traffic control
description: Flight Sim is a game where you have to guide aircraft to their landing zones, keep the skies safe to complete the levels to get high score.

title: Lambo Traffic Racer
description: Lambo Traffic Racing, you will be playing lambo cars through endless highway. It is a great game for kids and adults. Great fun, great graphics and great lambos to drive .

title: Fruit Block Tetra Puzzle
description: Fruit Block Tetra Puzzle is a fast and fun block puzzle game where you place fruit-shaped blocks to clear lines and collect target fruits before time runs out. Complete each fruit goal to level up and unlock new challenges. Easy to play, satisfying to master, and perfect for quick, brain-boosting fun!

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Meeland.io
description: Meeland.io is a growing game-mode platform that invites you to build wealth through its lively Pet Tycoon experience. You’ll buy pets and eggs, earn steady income, and reinvest your profits to unlock stronger upgrades.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Cat Life Merge Money
description: Experience the life of a stray cat, beg from humans, earn money to buy food, and merge the money you beg to get more money. Only by acting quickly can you enter the rich cat life! First of all,all you need to do is click on the cat and let it beg all the time. Otherwise, it will be lazy.

title: King Of The Hill
description: Exciting pixel races to the top of the mountain! Choose a bright car, avoid all obstacles and reach the top of the mountain in one piece! Compete with other players and become the King of the Mountain!

title: CrazyZombies 3D
description:
Crazy Zombies 3D is a fast-paced top-down zombie survival shooter with cartoon-style 3D graphics. Use 10+ weapons to fight endless waves of zombies, conquer a town map, and unlock powerful upgrades. Battle 5 zombie types and 4 deadly bosses with unique abilities. Customize your loadout and survive as long as you can. Fun, intense, and addictive—can you survive the apocalypse?

?- Zombie Survival
?- 10+ Weapons to Master
?️- Conquer the Town
?- Boss Battles
?- Fun, Fast & Addictive

title: Las Vegas Poker
description: Play one of the most exciting card games in the world. Win up to 3 types of big tournaments and unlock your avatar. Rule the poker game and become King Of The Table. Collect daily rewards, customize your game mode, and live the excitement of Las Vegas Casino.

title: Color Brain Test Games
description: Color Brain Test Game is a ring puzzle game. Do you want to train your brain?  You love fun spinning circle puzzle games with simple and colorful gameplay. Play Color Brain Test Games now!

title: Nose Hospital
description: In Nose Hospital Games, The patients are counting on you in this nose surgery hospital game. Will you rise to the occasion and become the hero in plastic surgery games, they desperately need? Step into the operating theater and redefine the world of nose plastic surgery games.

title: Shell Strikers
description:
Shell Strikers is an exciting turn-based artillery combat game where strategy meets action. Lead your team of soldiers in intense battles across diverse battlefields including war-torn cities, scorching deserts, and peaceful meadows.

Each turn, you must carefully aim your shots, account for wind conditions, and choose the right weapon from your arsenal. Available weapons include rockets, bombs, laser guns, airstrikes, and dynamite - each with unique properties and limited ammo.

title: Hexa Sort Trick or Treat
description: Step into a haunted puzzle realm where glowing hexagonal blocks hide within a web of spooky challenges. Your task: sort eerie, color-coded pieces into their rightful places before the shadows close in. With every drag and drop, you’ll sharpen your wits and unravel chillingly clever layouts that grow trickier as you progress. Easy to pick up yet devilishly addictive, this Halloween brain-teaser will keep players of all ages spellbound through hundreds of spooky levels.

title: Tanks. Race for survival
description: In this exciting tank game, you compete with other players to be the first to reach the finish line, destroying enemy towers along your way. Control powerful tanks, use tactical thinking and strategic maneuvers to overcome obstacles and defeat opponents. Carefully plan your route, avoiding enemy attacks and traps on the path to victory. The thrilling survival race begins here!

title: Quiz Master
description:
Quiz Master is a fast-paced casual quiz game where you race against the clock—and other players—to prove you’ve got the wittiest brain in town.
Each match drops you into a question showdown spanning everything from pop culture and geography to brain-rot challenges.
When you answer a question correct you get 1 Block that will save you. If you pick the wrong answer you will stay where you are.
The water rises so make sure to answer correctly or you get eaten by the sharks.

title: Penguin Adventure
description: Join the penguin’s adventure in Penguin Adventure! You will play as a penguin who must reach the castle in each level. You will explore three worlds, each with its own challenges and surprises. You will also have to control the penguin’s actions. You will collect stars and hearts along the way, which will affect your score and rewards. You will need enough yellow stars to unlock the next world. Penguin Adventure is a game that will test your reaction and strategy. Don’t miss this fun game!

title: Penguin Farm - Ice Merge
description:
Explore a world of frozen islands where penguins run their own farm. Collect resources, merge wood, build and upgrade buildings to open up new territories. Develop your settlement step by step, expand your glaciers, and watch your income grow.
Train your penguins, improve production, and head to the ocean for rewards—there drift chests filled with valuable treasures. Upgrade each building, manage your resources, and turn your small island into a thriving icy farm.

title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake
description: Whip up layers of color and sweetness in Tiny Baker Rainbow Buttercream Cake! Mix, bake, and frost your way to the perfect rainbow treat, then finish with cute decorations that make your cake sparkle with charm.

title: Cake Merge
description: Cake Merge is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you build whole cakes from colorful slices. Clear the tray, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and unlock new desserts as you play. With smooth animations, cute visuals, and easy-to-learn gameplay, Cake Merge is perfect for fans of casual merge, sorting, and matching games. Earn points, level up, and enjoy the sweetest merges!

title: EQ Test Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that tests emotional intelligence through emotion recognition and jigsaw puzzles. Match emotional icons, scenarios, and puzzle pieces to train your emotional awareness and problem-solving skills.

title: Hexa Block: Honey Cells
description: Dive into the exciting world of logic and shapes. Your task is to fill the field with multi-colored hexagonal blocks, choosing the right combinations. Each level is a new puzzle that requires attention, logic and precise calculation. Exciting gameplay, smooth animation and bright graphics make the gameplay as enjoyable as possible.

title: Winter Maze
description:
Step into a frosty puzzle adventure with Winter Maze! Explore icy, snow-covered mazes and guide your ball through slippery, twisty paths that fill up with every move. Each level challenges you to think ahead, plan your route and clear the entire field to unlock the next stage.
Simply swipe to roll the ball in any direction and watch the maze come to life beneath you. Your goal is clear: cover every tile and leave no space untouched.

title: Sigil Seeker
description: Welcome to Sigil Seeker!\nEmbark on a quest to collect mystical sigils by tapping tiles on the screen. Add tiles to your row, aiming to gather three identical sigils to collect them. Your goal is to gather all the sigils before time runs out. But beware, if your row overflows or the clock reaches zero, the game is over.\nAre you ready to become the ultimate Sigil Seeker? Dive in and start your adventure now!

title: Hedgies
description: Hedgies is a charming farming game where a hardworking hedgehog transforms an abandoned plot into a thriving homestead. Grow crops, craft goods, and master skills like cooking and fishing.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: FreeCell
description: Unlike other card games that rely on luck, almost every game of FreeCell is solvable—if you have the skill. Use the four open "free cells" as temporary holders to juggle your cards and organize the chaotic tableau. Plan your moves carefully, stack cards by alternating colors, and clear the board. Whether you want a relaxing break or a serious brain workout, this is the perfect puzzle for you.

title: Sprunki 3D Shooter
description: Sprunki 3D Shooter delivers nonstop action as you face off against waves of Sprunkies! Your mission is simple: shoot to survive as long as you can. Run out of ammo? Search the battlefield for scattered rounds to keep the fight alive. Gear up and prepare to take on the Sprunkies—can you last the challenge?

title: Make Two
description:
In Make Two, your job is simple. Give each customer two of the same food! Drag the matching items to the hungry customers before time runs out.

- Beat the clock to clear each level
- Match food pairs to fulfill orders
- Earn coins for every satisfied customer. The more you serve, the more you earn!
- Use your coins to unlock new cute customers.

Fast-paced, satisfying, and easy to pick up. Make Two is the perfect bite-sized game to test your reflexes and memory.

title: Gladiator Fights
description: An action game based on battles with gladiators, where players can plunge into the world of ancient Rome and become real warriors. The game offers an exciting and dynamic gameplay where players have to go through many challenges and defeat a number of dangerous opponents.

title: Brain Test: One Line Draw Puzzle
description: In this engaging one-line puzzle game, challenge your brain by drawing shapes in a single stroke without lifting your finger. Each level presents a unique shape that must be drawn in one continuous line, testing your logic and creativity. With increasing difficulty, you’ll need to plan your moves carefully to solve each puzzle. Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers hours of fun while improving problem-solving skills. Can you master the art of drawing each shape in one go?

title: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
description: Color Nuts & Bolts Puzzle is a fun and engaging puzzle game that challenges your spatial imagination and color-matching skills! Match colorful screws to their corresponding nuts and watch as your puzzle-solving skills bring vibrant images to life. Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers hours of brain-teasing fun with a visually satisfying reward at the end of each challenge. Test your logic, precision, and creativity in this unique puzzle-solving adventure!

title: Cryptogram
description:
This game is for people who do not just look at letters but see the meaning behind them.
Each phrase hides a thought that can be revealed if you use logic, intuition and persistence.

title: Home Pin 2
description:
Welcome to chapter 2 of the Home Pin. Start your adventure of the pin world in the secret manor!

You want to protect the family? You want to create your own manor and restore the beautiful manor to its former glory? Play Home Pin 2: Family Adventure now - a unique pull pin game with a family storyline you can’t ignore. No more fake ads, this is the game you are looking for!

title: Freddys Nightmares Return Horror New Year
description:
Immerse yourself in this 3D game there's no need to fear the monster Freddy. To familiarize yourself with the area, play the escape mode. You'll find yourself in a mysterious, forgotten city on New Year's Eve, with snow making escape difficult. Go out of there as quickly as possible and see how far you can go.

Freddy Krueger and his snowman minions will relentlessly pursue and attack you in the second game mode, but you have the option to bring weapons to help you destroy them.

title: Mega Shark
description: One shark and a sea full of delicious fish. How hungry are you? You’ve got 60 seconds to prove it! Feed nonstop, survive the deepest waters and rely on your shark’s speed, strength and invincibility to complete each hunt. Collect coins and trophies to unlock and explore new stages.

title: Blastify II
