You only need to dodge enemies and their bullets because of automatic attack. When you earn some gem resources, you can use them to upgrade your character, Skills, and Talents.

title: Legend of Fireball
description:
Fireballs are your weapon of choice as you tap on objects to obliterate them and earn rewards. Every tap brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Fireball King! Collect various fireballs, costumes, and upgrades, enhancing your powers with every victory. Master cool fireball skills to crush objects even faster and more efficiently.
Race against time to demolish all targets in thrilling challenges, proving you're the strongest fireball wielder in the universe!

title: Brain Draw Line
description:
Brain Draw Line is a minimalist puzzle game where you must complete shapes using a single, continuous line. There are no timers or unnecessary distractions — the focus is purely on precision and planning. Each level presents a unique figure that you must finish without lifting your finger or mouse and without crossing the line twice.
The experience is calm, strategic, and rewarding — ideal for players who enjoy logic-based challenges.

title: THE SURVEY
description:
After a long work time when you ready to play games in your computer and start a survey  and it's shows you the things that you don't want to watch and know!
- 5-10 min Gameplay
- Atmospheric Enveronment
- Intrective Gameplay

title: Cloak Master Shooter Run
description: Cloak Master-Shooter Run allows you to show your shooting and running skills in an exciting environment! In this casual game, you will be transformed into a mysterious hero. Navigate through different scenarios, avoid obstacles and complete challenges.

title: Color Hoop Sort
description: Color Hoop Sort Puzzle Game is a fun and relaxing online puzzle where you sort colorful hoops onto rods. Test your logic and focus as levels get harder! Perfect for all ages, this brain-teasing game will keep you entertained for hours. Play now and see how far you can go!

title: Snake King
description: Get ready to slither your way to the top in this addictive take on the classic Snake game! As the Snake King, you’ll navigate through a maze-like arena, avoiding collisions with the four walls and your own tail.

title: LampHead
description: The main character of this game is an amazing man with a lamp instead of a head who needs to get out of a dark and dangerous strange place at any cost. Are you ready to prove that you have an outstanding reaction, maneuvering between sharp obstacles, collecting bonuses, remembering that at the end of each dark path the light of victory awaits you? We are ready to offer you a one-time runner in which tedious jumps are replaced by moving the main character between two equal planes.

title: Stacking Match
description: Jenga match is a very fun puzzle game. Players need to pull out blocks of a certain color from a multi-layered tower of blocks. The pulled block will fly into the corresponding colored square. When there are three blocks of the same color in a square, it will eliminated, and a new square will appear. How many levels you can play?

title: Survival master: 456 Challenge
description: Surval master: 456 Challenge is a sequel where participants undergo unique survival tests, facing moral dilemmas and dangers. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Press "A" to Party
description: Press A to Party is a casual arcade game collection designed for players of all ages. Gather your friends and family, settle onto the couch, and dive into the action with simple one-button controls and fast-paced gameplay. Compete against up to 4 players on the same screen, vying for the coveted title of the ultimate arcade champion. Get ready for a blast of fun and excitement at your next gathering!

title: Hexa Blast Game Puzzle
description:
Hexa Blast Game Puzzle is a fun and challenging game! Try to find the right combination of hexa puzzle. Just drag and drop all the hexa block game on the board. The rule is simple: everything must fit! Enjoy the satisfaction of pieces fitting neatly in place.
Our unique hexagonal pieces will stretch your mind in ways you never imagined in this addictive hexa block puzzle game.
Keep your brain active and sharp, analyze all the possibilities and try to finish all puzzles.

title: Riders Downhill Racing
description: Get ready to join the riders in an exciting adventure with Riders Downhill Racing! Choose from various game modes, including free ride, race, and career, available in both 1 player and 2 player modes. Experience the thrill of riding different vehicles, such as ATV bikes, cross bikes, and speed boats, while wearing different costumes. Join any mode and have a blast! Remember to collect diamonds during the free ride to unlock more items.

title: Wave Dash : Geometry Arrow
description: Ride the wave in Wave Dash, a rhythm platformer where each tap steers your arrow through tight corridors. Read patterns in waves, time jumps to music, and beat brutal stages. Build routes with the level editor, share creations, unlock icons, chase ranks, and perfect speed runs. Simple controls, fast restarts—pure focus and flow. Inspired by classic geometry platformers, tuned for dash mastery.

title: Falling Blocks Puzzle
description: Falling Blocks Puzzle is a timeless puzzle game where players arrange falling geometric shapes, to form complete horizontal lines. As lines are completed, they disappear, and players earn points. The game ends when the stack of shapes reaches the top of the screen. It’s a test of strategy and quick thinking, beloved by gamers worldwide.

title: Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle
description: Get ready for Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle, the ultimate test of logic and fun! Untangle the traffic, move the cars, and clear the way in this addictive puzzle adventure. With every level, new challenges appear—packed parking lots, tricky buses, and colorful traffic jams waiting for your brainpower. Easy to play, hard to master, and endlessly entertaining.

title: Light Line
description: Can you fill this maze with a single touch? Light Line is a game where you fill in every empty square with a single touch. Try harder stages as much as possible. Move the light lines to the delight of filling in the blanks perfectly.

title: Ship Parking Game
description: Solve colorful passenger seating puzzles on ships in this unique traffic jam puzzle game. Help passengers find their seats based on color patterns while managing the flow of people through parking lot-style challenges. It's not just about parking - you're a traffic director managing passenger jams on the high seas.

title: Walkers Attack
description: Walkers Attack is an action-adventure game. The end of the world is coming, make your way through a world full of danger and survive! Experience non-stop action with auto-fire and strategic movement. Gather resources, defeat hordes of zombies, and complete missions to unlock new themed levels ranging from sci-fi to medieval and urban. As the levels increase, so does the challenge. Are you ready to embark on a survival adventure? Can you be humanity's last hope? Good luck!

title: Mega Jump
description: Mega Jump is a fast-paced vertical arcade game where you leap from platform to platform, collect coins, and dodge hazards as you climb higher. Power-ups, shifting coins, and colorful boost stars keep every ascent exciting. With vibrant visuals and responsive movement, the challenge grows as you push for your highest score without missing a single platform.

title: Pickle Ball Clash
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Pickle Ball Clash — a thrilling sports game where every match is a battle of skill, speed, and strategy. Customize your character, unlock powerful paddles, and climb the competitive ranks from backyard brawls to pro-level leagues. Whether you're smashing winners or pulling off trick shots, the court is yours to conquer. Are you ready to clash?

title: Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color
description: Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color is a fun and addictive puzzle game. You must move the sheep from one enclosure to another in order to match them by color. When all enclosures contain only sheep of the same color, you win. Dozens of challenging levels await your challenge, allowing you to exercise your brain in a fun and colorful environment. Have fun playing!

title: Nitro Speed Car Racing
description:
Nitro Speed Car Racing is a very unique racing game. You need to focus on the pointer on the dial and stop it at the right moment to get the Nitro that can help you rush to the finish line. This
is a test of your quick reaction ability. Of course, you can use the coins you collected in the game to upgrade your engine and nitro. Come to a brain contest, stimulate your dopamine, and
challenge your reflex limit!

title: Cooking World Reborn
description:
The goal of the game is to go all the way from a small food truck to a large cafe in the center of the airport.

What awaits you:

- More than 50 large levels

- Various improvements to kitchen equipment

- Several game modes

title: Ball Rolling Slope
description:
Navigate a rolling ball through endless neon slopes in the Ball Rolling Slope game! Test your reflexes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the highest score in this challenge.
Ball Rolling Slope game is an exhilarating 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Guide a rolling ball down a steep, neon-lit slope filled with challenging obstacles and sudden drops. The gameplay is simple to pick up but difficult to master.

title: Screw Puzzle Master
description: Pull out the nuts and bolts and release the woods. Get ready for a fluent and entertaining screw puzzle! It is time to do some brain practice. Many game levels, entertaining puzzles, and super power-ups await you!  Challenge a friend and complete chapters as fast as you can. Place the bolts as strategically as you can. Buy different skins and play in a different ambient.

title: 12-in-1 Solitaire
description:
Solitaire is one of the most popular – if not the most popular – card games in the world! Experience premium Solitaire gameplay at its best with 12 of the world's most popular Solitaire games!

Welcome to our latest & most comprehensive collection of the world's best & most popular Solitaire games! We included 12 of the most beloved Solitaire games in 1 comphrehensive collection, added helpful features appreciated by both Solitaire pros and amateurs alike.

title: BFFs Y2K Fashion
description: Welcome to BFFs Y2K Fashion, the exciting new fashion designer game that lets you explore the trend of the year 2000! With a wide selection of styles from the decade, you can create the perfect look and express your fashion sense. From skater girl skirts to ripped jeans and t-shirts, or even the classic Y2K look with fun-colored low-waisted jeans and crop tops, you can customize your outfit and become an ultimate fashion designer. Play now and let your style shine!

title: Donut Run
description: This thrilling arcade game is designed for adventure enthusiasts and fans of active gameplay. Step into the role of a fearless rolling character, racing through dynamic levels filled with vibrant settings and exhilarating obstacles. With easy-to-master controls, you’ll quickly dive into the action, experiencing a blend of tension and adrenaline. Each level features diverse obstacles and traps, ensuring every run feels fresh and exciting.

title: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon
description: Want to become the best restaurant tycoon? You’ll build your own panda-themed food empire in Panda Kitchen: Idle Tycoon. Earn idle profits, and manage your way to success. Unlock new dining tables and kitchen equipment to improve efficiency. Recruiting chefs and servers to create an ultra-efficient restaurant team.

title: Woodland Slide
description:
Embark on a relaxing journey in Woodland Slide! Slide the colorful jewels across wooden planks to create perfect matches and clear the board.

With every move, a new row of gems disappears, adding to the challenge. Use your strategy and unlock powerful abilities to remove gems, split them into smaller pieces, or clear entire rows.

Explore a serene, nature-inspired setting while testing your puzzle-solving skills. How far can you go in this addictive quest for the perfect match?

title: Cat From Hell Cat Simulator
description: Become the troublemaking cat in Cat From Hell - Cat Simulator. Run wild inside Granny’s house, knocking things over and making a mess, such as breaking plates, throwing balls, smashing fish tanks, etc. Escape before she catches you. Explore, prank, and cause chaos in this hilarious and mischievous cat simulator. Every corner hides a secret that can be destroyed, and discover new challenges.

title: City Bus Driver
description: City Bus Driver is a fun simulation bus driving game where you can feel the experience of becoming a bus driver. Choose your favorite bus and complete the missions.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Merge Brick Breaker
description: Welcome to Merge Brick Breaker, the ultimate fusion of ball merging and brick-breaking action! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure that challenges your strategic skills and reflexes.

title: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!

title: Island Battle 3D
description: Jump and survive in Island Battle 3D, a 3D IO game that will keep you on your toes. You will play as a jumper who must avoid falling off the island. You will also have to knock back your enemies and be the last one standing. You will face a strategic challenge, as the island’s surface is constantly breaking and changing. You can use this to your advantage and push your rivals into the gaps. But watch out, they can do the same to you.

title: Match Ten Number Puzzle
description: Ready to put your brain to the test in a fun and relaxing way? Match Ten - Number Puzzle is a clever puzzle game that combines simple rules with surprisingly deep strategy. Once you start, you won’t want to stop! As levels progress, the board becomes more complex, and every number choice matters. Plan carefully, think ahead, and keep the board under control! If you enjoy number-based puzzle games, this one is a must-play!

title: Fighter Aircraft Pilot
description: Fighter Aircraft Pilot is a super realistic flight simulator game, part of our driving airplane collection. Sit in the cockpit of some of the most iconic aircraft in aviation history.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Labuba Halloween Infestation
description: Monsters are invading Halloween! You must destroy them all — the fate of Halloween is in your hands. The game features three different modes, each with tougher and more powerful monsters.

title: GT Formula Championship
description: GT Formula Championship is an exhilarating high-speed racing game that brings the thrill of Formula racing to life. Step into the driver’s seat of the most powerful and technologically advanced Formula cars as you compete against elite racers on world-class tracks. With intense competition, realistic physics, and breathtaking visuals, this game delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience like no other.

title: Mr Disc: Slingshot Strike
description:
Mr Disc is here to strike! Swipe, aim, and throw powerful discs to smash enemies, break obstacles, and clear every level in style.
Easy to play, hard to master – can you become the ultimate Slingshot Striker?

title: Counter Craft Sniper
description: Counter Craft Sniper is a first-person shooter where you step into the boots of an elite sniper sent to protect a city invaded by Minecraft mobs. Creepers, skeletons, and zombies have appeared in the middle of downtown, and only your precision and quick reflexes can stop them before the chaos spreads. Armed with your trusty sniper rifle, you must take position on rooftops and high vantage points to eliminate every hostile target that threatens the civilians below.

title: People Playground 3d
description: Playground 3D is an exciting physics-based 3D battle simulator where you can create and customize epic fights between two teams: Blue and Red. Featuring ragdoll physics and dynamic fighter movements, the game lets you design thrilling combat scenarios.

title: Drive To Survive
description:
Dive into the world of the zombie apocalypse, where your car is the only weapon!
Shoot down hordes of zombies, earn money and unlock new powerful cars.

Earn money - use your skills to become a master of survival!
Buy cars - from classics to supercars!
Explore new locations - each level is full of challenges!

Show the zombies who's boss!

title: Frog Knight
description: Frog Bubble your mission is to help a spirited frog pop an array of mischievous bubbles! Using your swift reflexes and strategic skills, you’ll throw your lily pad-shaped projectiles at bubbles to clear each level.

title: Delicious Emilys New Beginning Valentines Edition
description: "Delicious Emily's New Beginning Valentine's Edition" invites players to experience heartfelt moments in the culinary world. Join Emily as she embarks on a romantic journey, balancing love and career. This special edition celebrates Valentine's Day with captivating storylines, delectable challenges, and festive visuals. Engage in time management gameplay, serve delicious dishes, and witness the magic of love unfold. With its charming narrative and festive atmosphere.

title: Superwings Subway
description:
Explore with ASTRA:
Cross the space dodging all kinds of obstacles with Astra. Move along three rails dodging, jumping or passing under all kinds of traps and avoid meteorites.
Be careful, the rails are incomplete and you can fall into the void.

title: Snake 2048.io
description: Cubes are all around the arena and it is time to collect these cubes and merge them to have a longer 2048 cube snake! A great 2048 game begins with cube snakes and cubes in a huge arena. You will start with a low number of snakes, collect lower numbered cubes around the map, and try to make your snake bigger by combining numbers. Collect power-ups and give your snake more advantages.

title: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game
description: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game lets you build your perfect movie theater and run a profitable business. Choose the best films to satisfy guests and increase income. Expand parking, open snack kiosks, automate processes, and hire employees to optimize operations. Complete over 50 missions, enjoy colorful 3D graphics, and immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere. Buy movies, prepare snacks, and grow your theater to attract more viewers. Ready to become the top drive-in owner?

title: Rich Choice Run
description: Rich Choice Run is a fun swipe runner where every decision shapes your final lifestyle. Slide left and right to pick the best “boyfriend” choices and grab expensive items along the way. Your choices build your value and status—choose wisely, because one bad pick can ruin your chance.

title: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle
description: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle is an action fighting game where you, as a mighty Ultrahero. Battle against waves of evil monsters in a 3D world. Every battle is a new adventure. Feel the perfect fusion of tower defense and nervous arcade action in this game. As a hero, you must not only fight off monsters in epic battles but also use tower defense tactics to protect your base.

title: So Different Dragons
description: Discover the world of a new clicker game where you can trace the birth and maturation of your very unusual dragon pets. Each tap strengthens the strength of the dragons and speeds up time. Strategically build up your gold reserves to increase the number of your mythological pets and become the greatest guardian of dragons!

title: 4 Colors Card Mania
description:
4 Colors Card Mania is a thrilling and fast-paced card game inspired by the uno gameplay. Challenge against AI opponents in this colorful and strategic showdown.
Can you outwit your opponents and become the 4 Colors Card Mania champion? 
Shuffle the deck, deal the cards, and get ready for a colorful adventure!

title: Online Cats Multiplayer Park
description: Come to run, jump, guess, and race as a cute but competitive kitty in Online Cats - Multiplayer Park. It’s a real-time multiplayer chaos arena. Here are seven modes you can choose from. In Grab A Shabby Ball, for example, you will have to compete with your opponents and try to touch the ball to get points.

title: Happy Glass Game
description: Happy Glass is a fun and engaging puzzle game where your goal is to fill an empty glass with water. Draw lines to create a path for the water to flow into the glass. The less you draw, the higher your score. With 80 challenging levels, you’ll need to use your creativity and logic to make the glass happy again. Enjoy this delightful game on both desktop and mobile devices!

title: Food Card Sort
description: Food Card Sort is a unique and challenging 3D puzzle game that tests players' logic and reasoning skills. With a variety of food cards, each card displaying a different type of food, players must categorize them by placing similar foods together on the corresponding plate to pass each level.

title: Sort Works: Nuts & Order
description:
Sort Works: Nuts & Order is a fun color-sorting puzzle game where you organize colorful nuts onto matching bolts.

? How to Play:

* Tap a bolt to pick up the top nut.
* Drop it onto a matching color or empty bolt.
* Sort all nuts by color to win!

? Easy to learn, challenging to master, with hundreds of levels and a clean mechanical design—perfect for puzzle fans and casual gamers!

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: CRAZY VAN
description:
Operate your car to defeat zombies! Defeating zombies will earn you coins, which you can use to strengthen your car.
If you kill a lot of zombies, the time limit will be added, allowing you to defeat more zombies.

title: Pet Runner
description: Pet Runner is a fast-paced platformer where your pet runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Play in Endless Mode for infinite fun or tackle unique challenges in Level Mode. Use up to three lives, hit checkpoints, and complete daily challenges to earn coins. Unlock and customize adorable pets in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Pet Runner offers fun for all ages!

title: Obby Yard Sale
description:
Open your own trade right in the yard of your house! Order boxes with mysterious goods, unpack them and put them up for sale to passers-by. Each item can be common or rare and legendary, which makes every purchase special.
Keep an eye on your yard: buyers not only buy goods, but also try to steal them. Your task is to stop the thief in time and collect a collection of all types of items, turning simple yard trading into an exciting adventure.

title: Zombie Rodeo Multiplication
description: Don't let your zombie lose his head or other body parts in this Halloween themed multiplication math game. Answer the multiplication problem correctly before time runs out so your zombie doesn't lose a body part. If you answer incorrectly or time runs out before you get the correct answer, a body part falls off of your zombie. Once all of his body parts fall off, the game is over.  See how far you can go and earn coins to get upgrades.  Four difficulty settings to choose from.

title: Brainrot Cleaning
description: Welcome to Brainrot Cleaning, the weirdly satisfying cleaning simulation that turns chaos into calm. In this fun and quirky casual game, your job is to scrub away the mess caused by the wild world of brainrot characters and their hilarious antics! In the Cleaning Italian Brainrot or the Underwater mode, you will finish various cleaning tasks.

title: Horror Playtime Room Escape
description: Challenge your brain to break through the fog of horror. In Horror Playtime - Room Escape you will enter a mysterious story. You spend your birthday with Ye Chen on the roof of a building. The strange woman suddenly appeared and trapped you in a horrible room. Enter many rooms full of puzzles and horror! Use your brain to solve hidden things and uncover the truth of horror stories. Every detail in the room is full of mystery.

title: Sprunki Torches Maze
description: Light up all the torches in the room to unlock the door. Some torches are linked and will toggle together when activated. Watch out for bats! Contact with them results in a game over! Your goal is to exit the house through the front yard door.

title: Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Remove screws in correct order to get rid of the boards. 
Match the removed screws and complete the level. 
Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Backgammon Deluxe Edition
description:
Want to try a different kind of game of luck? Enjoy the best board game of luck, Backgammon Deluxe!

Challenge your friend to a game of chance and trust in the dice roll. Roll the dice with all your might and pray for a lucky number!

Who will come out on top in the end? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Strike Breakout
description: Strike Breakout is an intense rescue mission game where you're part of a specialized team sent to save the President and his security officers. You ride shotgun with a skilled helicopter pilot as you embark on a series of 10 nail-biting missions. Each mission drops you into enemy territory where you must stealthily navigate through enemy defenses, neutralize threats, and rescue the hostages.

title: Zombie Terminator
description: Zombie Terminator is an exciting first-person shooter game where players take on the role of a survivor in a world overrun by a zombie outbreak. Players must survive and hunt zombies in this post-apocalyptic setting. The game attracts numerous players with its intense combat experience and rich weapon system.

title: 2v2.io
description: 2v2.io is a fast-paced building game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fishing Baron Real Fishing
description: Fishing Baron Real Fishing is a casual fishing simulator that offers a realistic fishing experience. Enjoy a relaxing and challenging fishing journey. Become a fishing master. Start a fishing adventure across various beautiful fishing locations. From lakes to oceans, you can unlock different areas to fish. Each location has unique fish species and environments.

title: Paint Room Escape
description: Paint Room Escape is a puzzle escape game where creativity is key to finding your way out of a room with four walls, a desk, a shelf, an air conditioner, a safe, and a locked door. The only way out is to problem-solve your way to freedom by solving riddles using colors, paints, and painting tools that can be found throughout the room.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Battle Arena
description: Fight enemies, grow your army, and dominate the battlefield! Upgrade your camp, train your soldiers and earn tons of coins to expand your unstoppable arsenal. Ready to battle?

title: VegaMix Match-3 Village
description: A cozy match-3 with a heartfelt story! ? Visit grandma in the village — she’s a true star with fun tales from her youth. Play classic match-3 levels, earn stars and complete quests for villagers. Bright puzzles, touching stories, colorful graphics and daily bonuses await you. Perfect for short sessions and relaxing breaks. ? For fans of match-3 with plot, coziness and helping heroes.

title: Mobile Phone Case Diy
description: This is a mobile phone case game that was designed. Have you ever wanted to create a fashion phone case of your own? In the game, you can show your creativity, enjoy the art of customisation and see your phone evolve the way you like. You can choose your favourite colours, draw, mix, and spray paint your phone case.

title: Cyberpunk Agent
description:
Cyberpunk Agent is the most challenging shooting game available full of thrilling missions.
Get ready to enjoy this action packed eye popping game.
Your arena is attacked by scary zombies.
They want to eat civilians. They are planning the dangerous missions to harm the innocents.
Its time to save your people and kill all zombies.
Use your best assassin skills and fight with these scary zombies.

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: Build and Crush
description: Build and Crush is a multiplayer game in which you can, you guessed it, build and crush stuff. Choose your own fun!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bunny Boy Online
description: Play the exciting online game. Variety of weapons, grenades, maps to choose from, various game modes, dynamic gameplay. Play with friends to the game!

title: Sudoku Garden
description: Players must expand their thinking to solve puzzles in adventures. Learn to approach problems from different angles and discover hidden clues and patterns to overcome challenges. These games test wit while fueling interest and challenge-seeking mentality.

title: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
description:
Rediscover the captivating world of Solitaire Klondike!

This timeless card game not only entertains but also enhances logical thinking, offering hours of engaging pastime. Play your favorite solitaire anytime, anywhere.

Join the community of enthusiasts and prove your mastery in Klondike!

Keep an eye on the leaderboard and become the top player among all!

title: Princess Valentines Crush
description: Welcome to Princess Valentine’s Crush game. Princess Elsa has a crush on Jack Frost. She Invited Jack to the valentine’s party. Both have a plan to do some makeovers and enjoy taking some photos to post on social media. Join and help the beautiful couples. Have fun!

title: Nautilus Spaceship Escape
description: There is an eerie silence on the Nautilus, an intergalactic spaceship. You have just been asleep when the power goes out for a moment. An uneasy feeling creeps over you - something is wrong here. Could there have been an attack? Get up, explore the surroundings and find out what has happened!

title: Bubble Story
description: Bubble Story is a unique bubble game. As soon as you see bubble levels, you want to find the best combination that will give you maximum points and allow you to pass the level!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Backgammon Online
description: Backgammon Online is a casual game adapted from the original board game for online players. This is a game of logic that allows you to play the classic and ancient board game of backgammon against other players worldwide.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Street of Secrets is an atmospheric hidden object game where you become the lead detective. A mysterious case awaits, and your insightful assistant is there to help, offering hints and guiding you to crucial details.

title: Basketball Life 3d
description: Ready for the wonderful basketball challenge? Basketball Life 3D is a fun and creative sports game that tests your skills and timing! From classic hoop challenges to trick shots, every level is packed with excitement.

title: Stickman Jailbreak Story
description:
An exciting puzzle game in which the player will have to help stick make a daring escape from prison. Stick found himself in a sinister prison, from which there is no way out, except for various ingenious paths, hidden objects and puzzles.
The player will explore the various rooms of the prison, paying attention to every small detail and examining objects in search of key clues. Each room is filled with riddles, traps and various items that can be used to escape.

title: Formula Racing Games Car Game
description: Let's Play and Enjoy car driving in all the Formula Race master 3D tracks of the world and become a champion on all the tracks of the world in the Formula Car Racing Game. Formula Car Stunts Games 3D introduces a new offline car racing game for the fans of the Formula Car simulator.

title: Syder Hyper Drive
description: Syder Hyper Drive is stunt car game, based on futuristic theme. Perform different stunts from varieties of available vehicles, complete missions in this endless game.

title: ROYAL COIN RUSH
description: Drag adjacent coins to swap them, and line up three or more vertically or horizontally to remove them. Special coins appear when 4 or more coins are matched. Mix effects by combining special items! The stage is cleared when all the target coins are erased.

title: StarBlast
description: StarBlast is a fun multiplayer arcade shooter set in space. Mine asteroids and fight other players in your own fully upgradable spaceship.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fish Love Pins
description: Fish Love Pins is a physics-based game that requires players to actively use their brains to figure out how to complete each level. The game is very easy to play, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty gradually increases.

title: Stickman Kombat 2D
description: Stickman Kombat 2D is an action-packed fighting game where you are up against some fiercer opponents, each with their own set of skills and combat attacks. You aim to fight your way through challenging moves and defeat enemies to unlock new fighters and test your skills.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Lollipop Stack Run
description: Dive into a sweet adventure in Lollipop Stack Run which is a colorful parkour game! In this fun arcade game, keep running while collecting vibrant lollipops to stack your sweet tower. You need to be flexible and glide between various obstacles, making sure to collect as many lollipops as possible during the run.

title: Racing Island
description: Explore, race and prove your mastery! Go on an adventurous journey with unique vehicles. Show off your skills in race, freeride and stand modes. Each level is full of new vehicles and discoveries. Are you ready for leadership?

title: Obby +1 Pet Every Seconds
description:
Are you ready to become the owner of the coolest pet collection? Merge them, upgrade buildings and open new islands!

The game offers you:
- A constant influx of new pets - collect, merge and open rare ones!
- Upgrade your lab, market and home for even more opportunities
- Sell pets, earn money and build your empire

Open all the islands, pump up your pets to the maximum and create your own pet empire in "Obby +1 Pet Every Second"!

title: Christmas Blocks Sort
description: Blocks Sort Christmas Edition brings a cozy holiday twist to the classic sorting puzzle. All the blocks have turned into festive Christmas colors like bright red, pine green, frosty blue, and warm gold. They start mixed together in different columns, and your job is to sort them so each column ends up with just one color. The rules are simple, but the challenge is still satisfying. Think ahead, plan your moves, and slowly bring order to the holiday chaos.

title: Kaboom Miner
description:
A fast-paced logical arcade inspired by classic Boulder Dash, but taken to the next level with massive chain explosions.
Your goal is simple—but dangerous: destroy all 50 explosive crates. Use falling stones, carefully placed bombs, and clever terrain manipulation to trigger devastating chain reactions. Every move matters. Push stones, move crates, build bridges from bricks, and even trap the Ghost before finishing it off.

title: Latutu Holiday Gift Hunt
description: Latutu’s Holiday Gift Hunt is a cheerful matching game where you search through a pile of cute holiday toys and gifts to find three identical items. Drag each match into your slots to create a trio and clear space for more. With its cozy holiday theme, adorable Latutu characters, and satisfying match-and-clear gameplay, this game offers a relaxing yet exciting experience for all ages. Perfect for short sessions or high-score chasing during the festive season.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle
description:
Colorful bears are waiting to splash water!

Welcome to Cube Drop Puzzle!

Are you ready to start puzzle solving? Play Cube Drop Puzzle now and make a splash!

title: King of Crabs
description: Easy to operate the krab,The Shell Gallery will show each role's armor, speed, skill, and pelt,The Equipment shop sells 5 Claws, 5 Bodies, and 5 Legs, Claim extra claw coins in the Sign and Spin,The Quick Match will make a fight with 24 players.The Ultimate Guide to Winning Tactics and Tips,Find a shell first. Collect and eat fish on the ground to grow up, Attack the weaker opponents.

title: Robbie: Become a Beast
description:
Transform into a wild animal and train to become the fastest and strongest in "Robbie: Become a Beast"! 

?? Improve your endurance, compete against rivals, and prove you're the best runner. ????‍♂️ Get pets to help you train and increase your chances of winning. ?? Enhance your skills and become faster and stronger with each victory! ?? 

Are you ready to be the ultimate beast? Train, compete, and win in "Robbie: Become a Beast"! ??

title: Tung Tung Sahur in Geometry Dash
description: Join Tung Tung Sahur, the wooden drum-carrying dawn caller, as he bounces and flips through a neon cityscape just before sunrise! Dodge spikes, leap over traps, and time your jumps to the beat of his signature “tung-tung!” calls. In this Geometry Dash–inspired challenge, the streets are alive with glowing gates, speed pads, and tricky gravity flips. Can you drum your way to the end without missing a beat?

title: Giant Sushi Merge Master Game
description:
Giant Sushi is a relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to merge sushi!
Sounds easy, doesn't it? Take the challenge and become the new sushi master!

title: Obby: Pogo Parkour!
description: Obby: Pogo Parkour! is a dynamic arcade game where you control a character on a pogo stick, overcoming various levels filled with obstacles. Buy and upgrade your pogo sticks to complete challenges faster and more efficiently. Compete with players from all around the world and aim for the top of the leaderboard. Dive into the thrilling world of parkour on a pogo stick and test your reflexes in Obby: Pogo Parkour!

title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition
description: Relive 2024’s hottest fashion trends in Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition! From TikTok-inspired makeup to glamorous red carpet looks, this game brings together the best dress-up challenges of the year! Style iconic outfits, create bold beauty looks, and transform your favorite characters for every occasion—festivals, dates, holidays, and more! Are you ready to be the ultimate fashion trendsetter? Play now and own the style game!

title: Merge Gun Fps Shooting Zombie
description: Merge Gun: FPS Shooting Zombie's main mission is to shoot down all coming undead creatures before they kill you. Before you join the battle, you can buy more guns and merge the same guns into new advanced ones. With more powerful and fast ammo in the clip, you can deal with incoming enemies more easily. Both zombies and crows will move forward to you even if you are still reloading. Keep calm and shoot the explosive oil cans on the ground if necessary.

title: Pictures Riddle
description:
Guess 1 word based on shown 4 pictures
Discover what word can be related to pictures
Game has 2 modes: “Pictures” & “Riddles”
 
Features:
-     Simple & addictive gameplay
-     Challenging riddles
-     Hundreds of fun levels
-     …



** Credits:
-     Music by “Fred Patry”
-     Menu vector created by upklyak – www.freepik.com

title: Rocket Fest
description: Control the rocket to collect energy or other useful props along the way, and bomb the target at the end! This is a casual stress relief game.

title: Merge Drop
description: Buy and merge balls. Drop them to break the cubes. Every ball will multiply when they touch the cubes. If your balls can reach the end of the level you win.

title: Dreamy Home
description:
It's not just a game, but a warm and peaceful adventure that helps you feel the magic of ordinary moments.
Opening box after box, you will find personal items and lovingly find the perfect place for them. Room by room, step by step, you will assemble mosaics of memories and emotional stories hidden in simple objects.

title: Cross Connect Word
description:
Fun and relaxing crossword puzzle!

Cross Word Connect is a fun but challenging word game.
Enjoy modern word game with the combine of word search and crossword! In this fantastic crossword puzzle, you will improve your vocabulary and spelling skills.

title: Farm Triple Match
description:
Looking for a fun tile-matching puzzle game? Try Farm Triple Match, a fresh take on tile-matching for puzzle lovers! This mahjong-inspired game is easy to learn but offers exciting challenges.
Beat levels and build your own farm with cute animals and a lovely garden.
Classic gameplay with a modern twist for relaxing brain training.
Explore a variety of tiles featuring fruits, veggies, animals, and more.
Use boosters to conquer tough puzzles and keep progressing. No time limits—play anytime!

title: DuaLight - A Reflected Game
description:
DuaLight is a challenging 2D pixel art hyper-casual platformer. The true path lies in the reflection. 

Navigate levels where the real world tricks your eyes, and only those who watch the reflection below can move forward. Minimalist and short.

In DuaLight – A Reflected Game, nothing is as it seems… or rather, everything only appears in the reflection. You control a character in a world where invisible platforms can’t be seen in the real world, but only in the reflection below the screen.

title: Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames
description: Visit the BerryWorks cafeteria and play checkers, memory, tic-tac-toe, connecting pairs, and complete jigsaw puzzles with your friends.

title: Dungeon Master Knight
description: Embark on a medieval odyssey with Dungeon Master Knight, a riveting 2D side-scrolling action game. As a valiant knight, battle diverse enemies in a dungeon, employing automatic sword attacks as you approach foes and strategic shield blocks with the back key, and embrace the tactical use of rewarded video ads to revive, ensuring an immersive experience filled with combat and valor.

title: BFFs Luxury Loungewear
description: Get ready to style your way to comfort in the BFFs Luxury Loungewear game! Join the fun with Riri, Elsa, Polka, and Bonnie, each with a unique wardrobe. Choose from jersey cotton, knitted, velour, or silk sleepwear and accessories to create stylish sleepover outfits. Exercise your fashion skills and make every slumber party a plush, luxury affair. This game is perfect for budding fashionistas and dress-up game enthusiasts alike!

title: Obby Draw to Escape
description:
Have a blast in Obby illustrating your way to victory! Play the fun and relaxing casual game Draw to Escape and see if you can overcome the levels' issues using just your creativity.

You may earn money as you go through the levels, and you can earn even more coins when you reach the end of each level for every star you find. Things may vanish or explode and kill you, so be sure to check every level thoroughly.

title: Meow Block: Color Collect!
description: A burst of color, clever thinking, and adorable cats await you in Meow Block: Color Collect! This charming puzzle experience turns simple movements into brain-teasing fun, where every swipe matters and every match brings you closer to victory.

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Jelly Math 3D
description: Play Jelly Math 3D free online and explore a colorful browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Solve addition and subtraction, discover shapes, and tackle each logic puzzle in a playful 3D brain game designed for curious minds. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and built for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game that turns learning into quick, fun, skill-boosting play anytime.

title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
description:
Go solo in a free roam challenge where you can pull off incredible stunts like front and backflips. Navigate icy and dirt tracks as you push various vehicles to their limits.

In the multiplayer derby mode, choose your vehicle—whether it's a car, truck, or van—and engage in a fierce survival derby. Compete against all other vehicles in an intense, smashing battle. 

Jump into the action today and see if you have what it takes to rule the arena!

title: Obby Halloween Danger Skate
description: Obby is skateboarding on the rooftops and performing dangerous tricks. He wants to skateboard on the rooftops during Halloween. Help Obby reach the finish line safely. You must be very careful! Since it's Halloween, the city is flooded with toxic water, and if you fall from the building, you will die. Jump from barrels to containers and climb to the top of the building. Collect all the pumpkins along the way to earn money. Gather all the pumpkins and reach the finish line!

title: Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash
description:
Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash:
Explore a world where a geometric wave rushes through crazy obstacles, overcoming challenges one after another. Rhythm, chaos, and a splash of Italian madness — test your reaction and endurance in this geometric trial!

On different levels, you’ll encounter various Italian Brainrot animals: Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, Lirili Larila.

title: Riot Village
description: Step into Riot Village, a thrilling browser-based adventure where your shooting skills and strategy are tested. Navigate 10 intense levels with AI enemies. Visit the market to choose from 6 unique weapons and equip up to 4 in your inventory. Switch weapons during gameplay to overcome challenges. The game features automatic character movement, letting you focus on aiming and shooting. Adapt your strategy as each enemy wields different weapons. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Beach Club
description:
Calm down and manage your Beach Club!
Relax while listening to the waves, the ocean and some gulls. And soon you'll feel like you're floating around at the beach...
Let your helpers do all the work, stroll through the sand and collect the money from your customers.
Unlock new stuff so that even more people will come to your beach :D

Buy more seats, expand your beach and build your own empire!
Get some clean towels and make your Beach Club the most beautiful place.

title: Mind Games: Math Crosswords
description:
Mind Games: Math Crosswords is a game to improve your math skills. It is a great way to spend your time. 
The player's mission is to save the planet from extinction. The aliens have destroyed all the plants on the planet. However, humans have found a solution. Engineers have built ships that convert brain activity into life-giving energy to grow plants. By solving mathematical problems, you are contributing to the restoration of plants and the regeneration of our planet.

title: Mr Bounce
description: Challenge yourself with Mr Bounce, the brain-boosting puzzle game that will test your thinking skills and reflexes. Each level is a new puzzle demanding strategic planning and precise execution. Mr Bounce is more than just a game; it's a mental workout that improves your cognitive abilities.

title: IDLE Archeology
description:
Archaeological excavation simulator. Try to collect from the bones of a dinosaur!
Become the head of archaeological excavations.

title: Hard Rock Zombie Truck
description:
We ride on the roof of a truck, shoot, blow up and crush zombies!
This is a 2D shooter where you need to destroy crowds of zombies and monsters by shooting, crushing and exploding them. At the same time, it is necessary to save living people. We also upgrade our weapons and abilities! Lots of funny sounds, lots of blood (cartoonish!!!) and humor.

title: Slime Attack: Puzzle!
description: In this complete action, the play-heading playing you have to choose the right arrows and hit the corresponding slugs until it became too late. Calculate the time of shots, select colors and bring down arrows on top to protect your kingdom!

title: Money Grabber
description: In Money Grabber you collect Money before it goes into the Shredder! Upgrade your machines using cards in this survivor style tower defence game, you can unlock new cards using gems as a gacha mechanic and upgrade your machines using coins!

title: Last War Survival
description: The end is near. The world is no longer peaceful. In this game full of gunfights, zombies, and strategic challenges, you'll battle the evil zombies. Solving number puzzles to unleash your tactical genius. In Last War Survival, you'll play as a survivor in a world ravaged by a zombie virus.

title: Tile Adventure
description: A fun and satisfying tile-matching puzzle game! Match tiles in sets of three, clear the board, and enjoy a relaxing, brain-teasing experience. With smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and levels that gradually increase in challenge, it’s perfect for anyone who loves casual puzzles. (Inspired by the classic Mahjong layout, but with a fresh, modern twist!)

title: Cosmic Aviator
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey through the depths of the cosmos in Cosmic Aviator! In this pulse-pounding arcade-style game, you find yourself piloting a sleek aircraft that's trapped within a twisting and treacherous tunnel of unknown origin. Your mission? Navigate through the endless labyrinth of obstacles and hazards while collecting valuable power-ups to boost your score to new heights.

title: Overprotective Boyfriend
description: Imagine the beautiful Princess Marie standing in front of a mirror, looking at her reflection. Her eyes are shining, and a sly smile plays on her lips. She is ready to put on an outfit that will emphasize her grace and charm. But then her lover appears and frowns: «My dear, are you really going to wear such an open dress?» Marie knows that her faithful knight sometimes takes too much care of her, but today she intends to look dazzling!

title: Urban Assault Force
description: Step into the boots of an elite counter-terrorism unit in Urban Assault Force, an intense first-person shooter that plunges you into the heart of urban warfare. The city is under siege by a ruthless terrorist group, and it's up to you and your team to strike back and save the day.

title: Bus Color Jam
description: Welcome to Bus Color Jam, a lively and colorful online game that challenges your coordination and quick thinking. Guide passengers to the right buses by matching their colors and keeping the station running smoothly. Every level brings new challenges that test your timing and attention. It’s a fun mix of strategy and reflexes — easy to learn, satisfying to master, and completely free to play on both your phone and computer.

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. With simple gameplay and increasing challenges, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves casual puzzles and brain workouts. Your goal is to help the capybara solve various puzzle challenges. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

title: Gold Miner Tower Defense
description: Gold Miner Tower Defense is a wonderful combination of tower defense, card strategy and upgrade combat. You will play as a brave miner protecting gold from enemies. Protect your precious treasures strategically with many unique defense towers!

title: Football Stars Championship
description: Try a fresh take on a football game! The luck-based gameplay will keep you on your toes. Score extra points with precise shots that avoid the goalkeeper perfectly.

title: Brick Match
description: Brick Match is a fast, fun puzzle game! Tap to match colorful bricks, trigger combos, and beat brain-teasing levels. Use boosters like the Shuffle, Colour Bomb, Extra Moves, and Row Blaster to blast through tough spots. Can you clear the board and beat your high score?

title: Smash the Car to Pieces!
description: Shoot the car with guns. Launch a combat drone or summon a tornado. Ram the car with a giant hammer or blow up all the windows with dynamite. There are many ways to destroy a car waiting for you in this game.

title: Seafaring Memory Challenge
description: Set sail into the captivating depths of the ocean with Seafaring Memory Challenge! Match pairs of sea-themed icons in an endless array of levels. Test your memory skills as you uncover treasures like colorful fish, delicate sea shells, and sunken treasures. With no level limit, the adventure never ends, providing hours of entertainment. Stay sharp and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the waves!

title: Skating Park
description: Welcome to Skating Park, where skateboards meet high-speed racing madness! Dive into a world of adrenaline-fueled stunts and fierce competition as you shred through gravity-defying tracks. Master insane ramps, outmaneuver opponents, and conquer the leaderboard. Feel the thrill as you jump off the track, taking daring shortcuts to gain the edge. Get ready to grind and glide your way to victory!

title: Agent Squad
description:
Looking for an engaging casual shooter that’s easy to get the hang of but offers engrossing action and real tactical challenges? 
Agent Squad is a top-down shooting game with intelligent mechanics, loads of cool upgradable guns, and addictive gameplay

title: Bed Wars
description:
Take on the role of a commander, control your squad of stickmen, upgrade your soldiers, upgrade your base defense, get resources, fight on the battlefield with other players and capture enemy bases. And the enemy bases are their beds.
The game has many levels. With each level, the base becomes more and more difficult to defend, and opponents become more aggressive and powerful. Will you be able to maintain your position as a Leader and defeat everyone?

title: Zombie Survival Shooter
description: Ready for an all-out apocalypse escape? Zombie Survival Shooter throws you straight into a world overrun by zombies. Zombies attack from every direction. Keep moving, dodge smartly, and never stop running. Shoot the digital doors to gain more helpers or boost your attack speed, etc. Use your strategy to choose which digital door to go through.

title: Giant Run 3D
description: Giant Run 3D is a boy's free online game. You need to choose the correct doors to gather more people. The more people you collect, the bigger the giant you can merge at the end and the chances of winning will be enlarged. The game will eventually require your people to become a giant so that you can fight to the death with the final boss. Sprint all the way to the finish line to start fighting!

title: TearDown - Destruction SandBox
description:
The player is given complete freedom of action. You can explore various locations filled with structures. The main feature of the game is the ability to destroy everything you see.

Have you ever wanted to level a multi-storey house with your own hands? Now you have the opportunity to do just that! The physics of destruction is close to reality. You can use a variety of weapons to destroy objects, from a hammer to a powerful bazooka.

title: Garden Guardians
description:
A fun and strategic tower defense game that’s easy to pick up!
Tap directional arrows to launch seeds into flowerpots—each seed blossoms into a powerful flower ready to blast incoming zombies. Plan your moves, hold the line, and protect your garden from the undead horde!

title: Sorting frogs
description: A game in the sorting genre, but in the form of sorting frogs, great graphics, very many levels, and a large variety of frogs. Several variations of levels. Pass levels, get achievements, unlock new kinds of frogs!

title: 2048Skill Edition
description: Ini adalah permainan kesenangan untuk 2.048, dan terutama kami telah menambahkan permainan dan keterampilan baru yang memungkinkan pengguna untuk mengalami 2048 berbeda.

title: Warping Bat
description: In Warping Bat you have to bounce from spring to spring in order to collect all of the coins in the level which will then open the exit gate. Face more than twenty levels, avoiding obstacles, and bouncing around each level! Try your best and see if you have what it takes to complete the game in its entirety!

title: Miniblox
description: Miniblox is an online game featuring voxelated graphics and a diverse selection of minigames. Explore endless possibilities as you delve into a vibrant world of creativity and competition.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Candy Smash
description: Candy Smash is a lively and addictive puzzle game where players tap on clusters of sweet candies to clear them and rack up points. Plan your moves wisely to clear the board and set new high scores before your lives run out! Featuring bright, colorful graphics and a delightful candy-themed world, this match-and-clear adventure is perfect for players of all ages.

title: Mini Scrapbook Paper
description: Mini Scrapbook Paper is a super cute art game made for girls. Do you have a journal? Have you ever designed your journal with your own style? In this game, you can design a journal freely. With colorful pages, fancy stickers and other cute accessories we prepared for you, you can use your imagination as much as you like. Have a good time!

title: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion
description: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion is an action-packed horde survival game where you soar through the skies on a magical broom, battling waves of enemies! Defeat foes and gather experience points to level up and grow stronger. Unlock and master powerful spells, evolving them to take down enemies even faster. Good luck in your battles!

title: Fruit Sort Logic
description: Fruit Sort Logic is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you sort colorful fruit juices on shelves. Move the juices around and match three of the same kind to clear a shelf. Space is limited, so each move matters. Clear all shelves to finish the level and unlock new ones. With smooth controls, bright visuals, and endless levels, the game is easy to play and satisfying to master. Perfect for a calm but clever puzzle experience.

title: Sea Match
description: See Match is a challenging match-3 puzzle game. Connect 3 or more of the same fishes horizontally or diagonally. The more fishes you match, the higher your score! Keep an eye on the time. You will fail to pass the level if you do not gather sufficient grids in time. The faster you complete the task, the more stars you earn! If you find yourself stuck, you can always use the special bonuses to help you.

title: Assault Bots
description: We'd like to hear your feedback. Share your experience via this form to help us improve Assault Bots.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Stickman Football
description:
"Stickman Football" is an exciting 2D game where you take on the role of a stick football player and compete against an opponent. Your goal is to score using various moves and tricks.

You have the ability to teleport to the ball after a shot to improve your chances of scoring. This adds a strategic element to the game, as you must choose the right moment to use teleportation to get the ball into the goal.

title: Emoji Challenge
description: Emoji Challenge is an engaging skill game. Featuring levels constructed entirely with popular emojis. The game offers six distinct puzzle types: link puzzle, memory puzzle, word quiz, related puzzle, shadow puzzle, and crop puzzle. This game is perfect for players who enjoy brain teasers and want to test their problem-solving skills.

title: Wreck The Tower
description: Take control of a powerful tank and unleash destruction in Wreck The Tower, an explosive demolition game where precision and power determine your success! Your mission is simple: demolish buildings by firing your tank’s bullets repeatedly until the structure collapses. But be careful not to hit the moving walls. If you hit them, your bullet will ricochet back toward you, adding an extra challenge to your aim.

title: Cocktailz
description: Thirsty? Make all sorts of cocktails in this refreshing Match-3 game! Excessive alcohol consumption is harmful to health, but you can play this game without moderation.

title: Bubble Letters
description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Bubble Letters, an immersive word game that takes players on an extraordinary journey through the world of letters. Featuring vibrant floral backgrounds and tranquil gameplay, this online crossword adventure is the ideal companion for warm days ahead! With thousands of levels to conquer, you're guaranteed endless brain-teasing enjoyment. Embark on a blooming linguistic adventure today!

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Bunny Blox
description: Help the Bunny collect as many blox as possible. Match 3 or more items. Slide left or right to move the item. Slide up to rotate and slide down to drop the item. Special rewards appear during the game. Use them wisely to destroy strategic areas.

title: Metaxis
description: In Metaxis, a minimalist puzzle-platformer, if you stop moving, you die. Descend into a black-and-white underworld to save a lost soul, facing Death’s cruel challenge: succeed or stay trapped forever. Cross dangerous, changing isometric levels with quick reflexes and sharp thinking. Every step is a fight between life and death. Your only chance is to keep moving.

title: Metro Escape
description: On Metro escape you must search the room for items that will help you escape. Search for itens in the metro and use them to solve the puzzles. Look carefully at the various patterns around the metro and solve the riddles. Good luck to search for your way to escape!

title: Hypermarket 3D: Store Cashier
description:
Step into the world of retail and build the supermarket of your dreams! 

Manage customers, run the cash register, stock shelves, and keep your store thriving. From scanning groceries to cart-surfing adventures, every task brings your bustling market to life.

Take charge as the supermarket cashier, master time management, and turn your small store into a thriving grocery empire.

title: Survival Sword Battle
description: Survival Sword Battle throws you into a ruthless sword-fighting free-for-all battle where a single hit means defeat. Fight to unlock all 10 character evolutions and boost your speed with each upgrade. Can you dominate the leaderboard and survive the longest?

title: Golden Frontier
description: This simulation game takes you on a Wild West adventure. Mine and manage resources, grow crops and craft goods as you aim to build a thriving city in the frontier lands. Invite friends to become your neighbors to trade and co-op, and progress quicker. Hunt for gold, unlock new locations, and discover secrets as the story unfolds. Meet a colorful cast of characters, including trappers, Indians and criminals.

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.

title: Forgotten Treasure 2
description: Forgotten Treasure 2 is a puzzle game where you combine jewels to crash obstacles using your logic and go through numerous challenges. At the moment, there are more than a thousand levels and this is far from the limit.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
description: Welcome to ASMR Clinic, where relaxation meets rejuvenation! Our superstar guest is receiving expert care for acne-prone skin and rough feet in a serene atmosphere. Our skilled doctors will work their magic, providing personalized attention to detail and soothing care. Customize her look with various hairstyles, makeup looks, and shoes to create a stunning outfit that's uniquely hers. Unwind and express your creativity in this calming and fashionable game.

title: World War Brothers WW2
description:
⭐WORLD WAR BROTHERS⭐
World war brothers is a ww2 online first person shooter game. Play with your friends destroy enemy bases, capture the points. Traditional weapons, maps, and more will add soon. We need your feedbacks.
⭐ Features ⭐
- PvP multiplayer 8v8 Allies vs. Axis Teams
- Daily missions will come soon
- Omaha Beach, Pacific maps

title: The Sort Agency
description: You are the head of the best object sorting agency. Your goal is to bring order and cleanliness to the world. On the many levels you will be able to test your attentiveness and tactical thinking. Look for the right items in a pile of other items. But keep track of how many items you already have in your hands!

title: Rummy 500 Card Game
description:
Features :
- Offline game.
- 3 Super Modes: classic mode, 3 player mode and Speed mode.
- Auto arrange the cards
- Game statistics.
- Easy to play 
- Excellent and fair ai to play with.
- Continue the last game from where you left.
- No login required

title: Mahjong Garden
description:
Mahjong Garden offers players the opportunity to enjoy a classic puzzle game with no time limits and on full screen!
In this exciting game you have to connect identical chips in a certain sequence so that they disappear from the field, as well as immerse yourself in oriental culture!
Unlock new tiles and backgrounds to take a look Mahjong in a new way!
Raise your level of logic and visualization, making every move strategic!

title: Hearts: Classic
description: Hearts: Classic is an online version of the traditional card in which you are trying to avoid scoring points as the game ends when a player reaches 100 points. If you are new to the game of Hearts, then there is a handy rulebook that helps you through the game teaching you tips and how to avoid losing the game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Meow Market
description: In Meow Market, players take on the role of a charming white tabby cat running a bustling vegetable shop. To keep the business thriving, players must harvest fresh veggies by engaging in a click-match puzzle game. Selecting grouped matching vegetables to harvest them efficiently. Each harvest consumes one move, which regenerates over time, encouraging strategic decision-making.

title: Wordling: Daily Word Challenge
description: Wordling is a fun, free daily word puzzle game where you guess the hidden word in 6 tries using color-coded clues. Perfect for adults and seniors who love brain games, spelling challenges, and relaxing, ad-free gameplay. Explore all game modes!

title: Gift Merge Santa World Tour
description:
Gift Merge: Santa World Tour

Help Santa spread Christmas joy across the globe!
Tap to generate gifts, merge identical items to craft new toys, and fulfill children’s wishes to raise each country’s happiness. Travel from snowy towns to sunny beaches, unlocking new festive destinations. Merge, match, and make magic — the more joy you spread, the closer Santa gets to completing his world tour!

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Eat And Grow Fish
description: Welcome to Eat and Grow Fish, where survival is all about eating or being eaten! Start as a tiny fish and munch your way to the top of the food chain. Explore the levels in Story Mode, or challenge your friends in Duel Mode for two-player fun. Easy to play, fun to master! Are you ready to rule the sea?

title: Fishing Fishes
description:
Fish some fishes in Fishing Fishes with your fishing fishers


You'll start with a basic fishing setup, you get fishes and you can use them to buy new fishers and other upgrades that will help you get even more fish!


With intuitive controls, Fishing Fishes is a perfect game for anyone who loves fishing or management games. So what are you waiting for?

title: Cake Sorting Deluxe
description: Cake Sorting Deluxe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your sorting skills! Shift cakes across shelves to make matches of three or more. Clear the board, uncover hidden and shadowed cakes, and solve tricky puzzles as you go. With cute visuals, smooth gameplay, and lots of sweet challenges, Cake Sorting Deluxe is a treat for anyone who loves a good puzzle. Ready to mix, match, and clear the shelves?

title: Jungle Fury Mutant Rhino Mayhem
description: Enter a jungle plagued by mutant rhino warriors! As a brave tribal hero, rescue captured villagers, battle fierce enemies, and defeat powerful rhino bosses. Use bows, axes, and legendary weapons from the Blacksmith Shop to fight through deadly swamps, chaotic caverns, and fortified ramparts. Can you stop the Apex Mutant Rhino Warlord and restore peace to the land?

title: Goods Triple Match 3D
description: Begin a satisfying match-3 puzzle challenge in Goods Triple Match 3D, a colorful and addictive casual logic game where all items appear in beautiful and realistic 3D.Your table is filled with many cute 3D drinks, and your goal is simple: find and match three identical objects.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fight for the Tree
description:
The gaming world is facing a serious tree crisis. Evil forces are running wild, and the trees are in great danger.
As a player, your mission is to protect these precious trees. Even when you're offline, your character will keep fighting to safeguard the trees, constantly accumulating experience and resources.
In the game, there's also a group of cute little sapling creatures imprisoned by the evil forces. You need to rescue them one by one through battles, explorations, and so on.

title: Russian Checkers
description:
Russian Checkers with computer, Online with real people or Together on same screen.
Game Modes:
- With a computer
- Online
- Online with a friend via the link
- Together on the same screen

title: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator
description: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator is a 3D strategy battle game where planning is the key to victory. Build your army of Swordsmen, Spearmen, and Archers, analyze enemy formations, and lead your ninja forces to triumph across challenging levels.

title: Mystical Blade 3D
description: Enter the world of Mystical Blades, where you design and battle your own B-Blades! Mix blades, rings, and elements to create powerful combos, then face players worldwide in thrilling battles. With stunning graphics and realistic physics, prove your skills and become the ultimate B-Blades master!

title: Traffic Jam Hop On
description: In Traffic Jam: Hop On, challenge your strategy thinking and quick reflexes! This wonderful puzzle game will take you into a colorful parking lot. Your task is to help all kinds of vehicles get out of traffic jams and start smoothly.

title: Fighter Stick Hero
description: Welcome to Figher Stick Hero Stickman, an exhilarating 2D stickman game that will test your dueling skills. Whether you're playing in an arcade or survival mode, get ready to engage in intense battles against your opponents. Choose from a variety of weapons, character colors, and character decorations to customize your stickman. Remember to attack while moving to gain an advantage and earn higher scores by defeating other stickmen.

title: Pizza Tycoon
description: Play as Boss Hei Wa, running a pizza shop! Serve food, collect payments, hire and upgrade staff, and expand sales channels. Manage and grow your business to success!

title: Tank Sniper 3D
description:
Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game
Are you a fan of shooting games? Do you have what it takes to be a sniper tank driver? Then youll love Tank Sniper 3D - the action game that puts your skills to the test. Shoot your enemies with one shot from behind cover. Stay hidden until you strike with a surprise shot. Then, dodge their fire and hit as many targets as you can. How long can you survive? Find out now and play Tank Sniper 3D!

title: Nightmare Couple Halloween Party
description: Nightmare Couple Halloween Party is a spooky and stylish dress-up game where you can help the ultimate nightmare couple prepare for their eerie Halloween bash. Select from a variety of creepy costumes, haunting accessories, and makeup styles to give the couple their perfect spine-chilling look. Unleash your creativity and fashion sense to make this Halloween party an unforgettable one for the nightmare couple!

title: Traffic Racing
description: Traffic Racing is a fast-paced driving game that throws you into intense highway action where every second counts. Weave through heavy traffic at high speeds as you compete in Career Mode or test your skills against others in Racing League Online.

title: Juicy Match 2
description: Juicy Match 2 returns with even more natural, fresh, and juicy fun! Step into the best Juice Bar in town and match delicious fruits to create perfect juice blends. Your cheerful Banana friend will guide you with helpful tips along the way. Match three or more fruits to juice them, trigger chain reactions for big bonuses, and master hundreds of new levels. With Daily Missions, Weekly Challenges, and endless juicy puzzles, the adventure never stops in Juicy Match 2!

title: Bubble Blast
description: Bubble Blast is a fun, casual bubble shooter game where you pop bubbles and complete quests. This is the classic game you find yourself and those around you playing on your morning commute to work.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bubble Shooter
description: Bubble Shooter is a popular casual game that combines simple mechanics with an addictive rewards system. Based on the arcade classic Puzzle Bobble (1994), Bubble Shooter challenges players to aim and shoot a bubble cannon to clear as many colorful bubbles off the screen as possible.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Join Ellie in Festival Vibes Makeup, a vibrant game radiating the spirit of the summer festivals. Delight in creating neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge makeup looks as you test your makeup artist skills in this colorful makeup game for girls. Mix, match, and shine with stunning eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, and glitter eyebrows!

title: Mergest Kingdom
description: Mergest Kingdom is a merge puzzle and match-3 game where you create your kingdom by combining items in threes. Match resources to unlock new items, complete quests, and grow your land.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Packing Line
description: Ship all the cans. Choose a box of the same color as the can. The game is over if you run out of space for boxes and the line stops.

title: Chicken Banana Quest
description: Help the Chicken and Banana to solve all puzzle quest and find the play button. Use your skills to solve the puzzles before the lives run out and complete all levels with the less possible clicks

title: Yummy Tales 3
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 3 — the fun and addictive Match 3 puzzle game! Match 3 or more fruits and veggies to feed your farm animals and reach level goals before you run out of moves. Enjoy over 2500+ exciting levels, daily missions, and challenges. Collect daily gifts, boosters, and fantastic rewards to help you beat tricky puzzles. Harvest the fun and start playing Yummy Tales 3 now!

title: Candy Pop Mania
description:
Dive into the enchanting world of matching games - Candy Pop Mania - where delightful fun and challenging games await! Pop, blast and match 3 sweets to keep on the adventure! Use combos and reach the best results!
Challenge yourself to win all of the levels of Candy Pop Mania!

title: Push.io
description: Push.io is a fast-paced arena game where you battle to stay on the map and push everyone else off. Wield your boomerang with precision to knock rivals into the water while dodging incoming attacks. The longer you survive, the higher you rank; fall early, and you’ll drop in the standings. Earn trophies, upgrade your boomerang between rounds, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate arena champion.

title: Number Merge 10
description: Number Merge 10 is a very innovative math puzzle game.Select a rectangular area, and if the sum of the numbers within that area equals 10, all the numbers in that area will be eliminated!

title: Gym Muscle Merge Tycoon
description: Gym Muscle: Merge Tycoon is an addictive game where you create your team of fighters and transform them into real muscle heroes. Connect fighters to strengthen their muscle mass, improve their characteristics, and earn profit. Participate in fighting tournaments to compete for cool rewards and become the most powerful fighter of all time!

title: Foam and Find
