description: Foam and Find is a relaxing hidden object game with a playful bubble twist. Explore cozy houses, each filled with charming rooms and easy-to-spot hidden items. Your tasks appear inside floating bubbles — and when you find an item, it flies into its bubble and pops with a satisfying animation. No timers, no stress — just a calm, casual experience at your own pace.

title: Unscrew Wood Puzzle
description: Unscrew Wood Puzzle: Screw Jam is an engaging puzzle game that combines logic, strategy, and dexterity in a tactile experience. Players are challenged to solve intricate puzzles involving bolts, nuts, and screws. With hundreds of unique levels, this game provides a blend of relaxation and mental stimulation, perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. The beautifully designed wooden and metallic elements create a visually appealing and satisfying gameplay experience.

title: Wonders of Egypt Match
description: Begin a legendary journey in Wonders of Egypt Match, a thrilling Match 3 game set in Ancient Egypt! Join your guide, the Amara, as you match three or more gems and artifacts to uncover hidden treasures and secrets buried in pyramids, temples, and obelisks. With stunning visuals and immersive soundscapes, explore a world filled with ancient mysteries and challenges. Ready to prove your skills? Join the adventure and experience the wonders of Egypt today!

title: Associations - Word Connect
description: Associations - Word Connect is a clever word puzzle game that reimagines how you think about language. Instead of just forming words, you’ll discover the hidden relationships between them, linking ideas, concepts, and meanings in creative ways.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Mr Reckless: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, Nitro to escape the impossible.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Brawl Stars Sound
description: Listen to the voices and enjoy the visuals of the Brawl Stars characters. Start your sound-filled brawling adventure and enjoy a unique auditory twist in your gaming routine!

title: Color Block Jam 2
description: Play Color Block Jam 2 free online in your browser with no download and no install required. This free online puzzle game lets you slide colorful blocks into matching gates through smart logic levels designed to test your brain and timing. description:
Command heroes with unique abilities, gather natural resources to produce materials, then build and develop your military defenses.

description: Embark on a mystical journey in Castle Craft, where you merge resources and unlock the secrets of time. Start in a land cloaked in fog, using ancient keys to reveal hidden territories and trace your lost family's steps across eras.

description:
Welcome to Art Puzzle Master, a fun and challenging puzzle game that will test your logic and problem-solving skills! 

In this game, you'll be presented with a series of beautiful artworks that have been divided into small, jumbled pieces. Your task is to rearrange the pieces and form the complete image, but be careful – the puzzles get more difficult as you progress through the levels!

title: Cars Derby Arena
description: Welcome to the world of Car Derby Arena! In this exciting game you can enjoy the unique experience of changing the color of cars, improving their performance, and manipulating gravity and weather conditions. Your goal is to become an invincible master of destruction, pump up your car and crush everything in your path. Embark on exciting missions, compete with other players and prove your skills in this epic Car Derby Arena game!

title: Build a Go-Kart
description:
Build your karting empire from scratch — from simple straights to complex tracks with boosts and risky turns.

Design unique tracks using modular blocks: combine elements, optimize your route, and find the perfect balance between speed and profit. Every ride earns money — and your track design determines how much you make.

title: Ghostly Graveyard Halloween Special
description:
This Halloween, experience the thrill of Ghostly Graveyard is a spooky platformer adventure where you explore a haunted graveyard and unravel its mysteries. Navigate challenging levels, collect coins, and avoid ghostly encounters. Can you solve the graveyard's secrets?
A Halloween Special Spooky Puzzle Adventure.

title: Mighty Run
description: Mighty Run is an action-packed platformer where you jump, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies to progress. Collect gifts along the way and reach the end to grab the diamond, unlocking the next level. Use power-ups, master tricky jumps, and overcome challenges in this thrilling adventure. With smooth controls and exciting gameplay, every level is a test of skill. Can you collect all the rewards and reach the finish line? Play Mighty Run now and prove your skills!

title: Grow a Garden 3D
description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! ?
Explore different seasons, customize your character, and watch your garden grow bigger every day.
Every seed is special and every garden is unique!

title: Dr. Parking
description: Ready to test your parking skills? Welcome to Dr. Parking - the super addictive car simulation game designed for all the boys who love a true driving challenge. In the game, you will drive various types of vehicles. Traverse the obstacle-laden parking lot and change corners and park your car precisely in the designated spot. And keep an eye out for keys. Each level is a test of your precision, patience, and driving instinct.

description: 2 Player Mini Challenge is an online casual game. If you want to play with your friends on the same device, or if you want to play alone against the AI, this is the game for you! This 2-player game collection features beautifully minimalist graphics that allow you to focus on going head-to-head with your opponent. The more participants you have, the more fun you'll have as you practice skills, react quickly, and interact with friends, relatives, and coworkers in a whole new way.

description: Slide the monster to help it eat all the zombies in the way. Use your strategic thinking and problem solving skill to avoid all obstacle and reach the gate to go to the next level.

❄ Fishing is a great kind of recreation and an opportunity to spend time with excitement! If you are a real fisherman at heart and are ready to test your skills, then this ice fishing game is just for you.

? Wherever you are in winter or summer - you can always find yourself on snow-covered ice among beautiful winter landscapes. Drill, rod, bait and a lake that always bites, what else does a born fisherman need?

description: Mask Evolution 3D is a parkour game. Move the masks through digital gates to boost the value of your mask. You can also collect decorations and attendants to make your mask even more artistic. Finally, auction your masks to sell them for a high price and earn more money. Please note,be careful of obstacles such as spikes on the road, they will devalue your mask and you will fail when your mask value is 0. Get ready for an exciting journey to make your very own mask!

description: Welcome to Dream Room Makeover, part of the beloved Room Makeover game! You've just purchased a charming old house with a sprawling garden, but it's in need of some TLC.
